sa: स तं विदित्वा तु भृगुनिश्चक्रामाश्रमात् तदा। पूजयामास च ततो विधिना नृपसत्तमम्॥
en: Knowing that it was Pratarddana who had come, the Rishi Bhrigu himself came out of his hermitage and adored that best of kings according to due rites.

sa: अस्मिन् मुहूर्ते द्रोणस्तु पाण्डवं गृह्य हर्षितः। आगमिष्यति नो नूनं धार्तराष्ट्रस्य संयुगे॥
en: This very moment Drona, having captured in battle the son of Pandu, will, being transported with joy, surely return to us and to the son of Dhritarashtra.

sa: एषोऽहिताग्निश्च महातपाश्च वेदान्तगः कर्मसु चाग्र्यशूरः। एतस्य यत्प्रेतगतस्य कृत्यं तत्कर्तुमिच्छामि तव प्रसादात्॥
en: He propitiated fire, performed great austerities, was conversant with the Vedas and the great performer of sacrifices. I desire to perform, by your instructions, his becoming obsequies.

sa: संजय उवाच ते किरन्तः शरवातान् सर्वे यत्ताः प्रहारिणः। त्वरमाणा महाराज युयुधानमयोधयन्॥
en: Sanjaya said Then, O mighty monarch, all those warriors accomplished in smiting down the foe and united together, began to fight with Yuyudhana quickly discharging numerous arrows.

sa: वैशम्पायन उवाच तथोच्यमानो मात्रा स सुहृद्धिश्च परंतपः। इत्युवाचाथ धर्मात्मा धर्म्यमेवोत्तरं वचः॥
en: Vaishampayana said : Thus addressed by his mother, relatives and friends, the chastiser of foes, the virtuousminded (Bhishma) said the following comfortable to the dictates of virtues.

sa: बालेन विष्णुना लोकास्त्रयः क्रान्तास्त्रिविक्रमैः। लक्ष्मणस्य वचः श्रुत्वा हेतुमत्परमार्थवत्।। अतिकायः प्रचुक्रोध बाणं चोत्तममाददे॥ ततो विद्याधरा भूता देवदैत्या महर्षयः। गुह्यकाश्च महात्मानस्तद्युद्धं ददृशुस्तदा॥
en: It was as a boy that Vişņu had overpowered the triune world with his prowess.” Hearing Laksmana's words, fraught with reason and high sense, Vidyadharas and ghosts, deities, Daityas out arrows and Maharşis, and the high-souled Guhyakas then beheld that marvel.* *The encounter that ensued between Lakşmaņa and Atikāya.

sa: ते स्वर्गभाजो राजेन्द्र भविष्यन्ति महामते। तथास्त्विति ततो राजा कुरुः शक्रमुवाच ह।।॥
en: Those men that will die here, having fasted with all their senses awake, and those that will die here in battle, shall, O king, come to heaven.

sa: बृहद् स्थन्तरं मूों वक्त्राद् वा तरसाहरौ। शिवं नाभ्यां बलादिन्द्रं वाय्वग्नी प्राणतोऽसृजत्॥
en: He created Brihat and Rathantara, who quickly steal life away. He created Shiva from his naval, Indra from his prowess and wind and fire from his soul.

sa: सोऽहं न केनचिच्चार्थी त्वां च धर्मादुपाह्वये। क्रोशतां सर्वभूतानां हाहा धिगिति जल्पताम्॥
en: I do not ask for anything. I shall, however, instruct you in the ways of virtue. All persons will croak and bray and cry fie on me.

sa: तस्मिन् पापे कृतघ्ने तु स्मृतिभिन्ने चलात्मनि। आर्यः को विश्वसेज्जातु तत्कुलीनो विशेषतः॥
en: What noble person, in especial, sprung in his race, shall any longer repose confidence in that impious one of unstable soul who has run amuck of morality?

sa: तयोः सुतीक्ष्णान् सृजतोः शरौधान् महाशरौघास्त्रविवर्धने रणे। रथे विलग्नाविव चन्द्रसूर्यो घनान्तरेणानुददर्श लोकः॥
en: And he too, decked with a diadem, covered Karna with sharp arrows. Creating clouds of sharp arrows in a battle rendered furious by huge weapons and shafts.

sa: वैशम्पायन उवाच सोऽभ्यनुज्ञाय राजानं वनचर्याय दीक्षितः। वने द्वादश वर्षाणि वासायानुजगाम ह॥
en: Vaishampayana said : Having obtained the king's permission, he made preparations to live in the forest. He went away to dwell in the forest for twelve years.

sa: म्लेच्छीभूतं जगत् सर्वं भविष्यति न संशयः। हस्तो हस्तं परिमुषेद् युगान्ते समुपस्थिते॥
en: There is no doubt the world will be then Mlechchhafield. When this Yuga would come, the right hand will deceive the left and the left the right.

sa: यदि मा मन्यसे वीर प्राप्तमर्हमिहातिथिम्॥ ततः सर्वात्मना त्वद्य युद्धातिथ्यं प्रयच्छ मे।
en: 'O hero, if you consider me to be your worthy guest, who am arrived here, then allow me, with your entire soul, the hospitality of battle today.'

sa: स वह्निः प्रथमो नित्यं देवैरन्विष्यते प्रभुः। आयान्तं नियतं दृष्ट्वा प्रविवेशार्णवं भयात्॥
en: That mighty chief fire (Svaha) is always missed by the celestials, for when he sees Niyata coming towards him, he hides himself in the sea for fear.

sa: एतेन तूर्णं प्रतिपादयेमान् श्वेतान् हयान् काञ्चनरश्मियोक्त्रान्। जवेन सर्वेण कुरु प्रयत्नमासादयेऽहं कुरुसिंहवृन्दम्॥
en: Soon take these white horses by this way, governed by golden reins. Do you quickly and carefully take me to the row of the leading Kuru heroes.

sa: जवेन मत्स्यान् किरीटिनं कृतकार्यं च मत्वा। दुर्योधनायाभिमुखं प्रयातं कुरुप्रवीराः सहसा निपेतुः॥
en: Seeing the kine run towards the city of Matsya's and considering Kiritin successful, the heroic Kurus all on a sudden withstood him who was proceeding towards Duryodhana.

sa: तदप्यस्त्रं महातेजाः क्षणेनैव व्यशातयत्। ब्रह्मास्त्रे तु हते राजन् भयं मां महदाविशत्॥
en: (But) that highly-energetic being instantly baffled even that weapon. And, O king, that weapon presided over by Brahma being destroyed, I was seized with a terrible fear.

sa: ते विकर्णं समासाद्य कङ्कबर्हिणवाससः। भित्तवा देहं गता भूमि ज्वलन्त इव पन्नगाः॥
en: Those arrows decked with the feathers of the Kanka bird, coming upon Vikarna and passing through his body stuck on the ground like so many hissing snakes.

sa: एष सूर्य इवाम्भोदैश्छन्नः पार्थो न दृश्यते। ध्वजायं दृश्यते त्वस्य ज्याशब्दश्चापि श्रूयते॥
en: Partha is not visible like the sun covered with clouds. The top of his car is being seen and the twang of his bow is being heard.

sa: सदृशैयुध्य माद्रेय वचो मे मा विशङ्किथाः। अथैनं धनुषोऽग्रेण तुदन भूयोऽब्रवीद् वचः॥
en: O son of Madri, you ought to fight with your equals (only). Do not mistrust my words." Then touching him with the end of his bow, he

sa: अपक्रान्ते च काकुत्स्थे लक्ष्मणे च यथासुखम्। आहरिष्यामि वैदेही सहस्राक्षः शचीमिव ॥
en: When both Rāma and Laksmana shall go elsewhere in this way, I shall to my felicity carry away Vaidehī like to the thousand-eyed deity carrying away Sací.

sa: राज्ये पुत्रः प्रतिष्ठाप्य सगुणो निर्गुणोऽपि वा। कथं शत्रुकुलीनं मां सुग्रीवो जीवयिष्यति।।।।।
en: Meritorious or otherwise, how can Sugriva, having installed in the kingdom me, son (of his enemy) and the enemy sprung in his race, suffer me to live?

sa: कर्तव्यो न तु वैदेहि मन्युस्त्यागमिमं प्रति। रामेणेदं विशुद्ध्यर्थं कृतं वै त्वद्धितैषिणा॥
en: It does not behove you, O Vaidehi, to be enraged (with Rāma) for renouncing you; for purifying you this was done by him ever wishing your welfare.

sa: कृतं त्रेतां द्वापरं च कलिश्च भरतर्षभ। राजमूला इति मतिर्मम नास्त्यत्र संशयः॥
en: I have no doubt also in this, O foremost of Bharata's race, that the setting of Krita, Treta, Dvapara and Kali, all depend on the king's conduct.

sa: कच्चिच्च निहतामित्रः प्रीणासि सुहृदो नृप। कच्चिच्छ्रियमिमां प्राप्य न त्वां शोकः प्रबाधते॥
en: Having killed all you foes, will you not please your friends, O King? Having secured this prosperity, I hope, you have nothing to be sorry of now.'."

sa: यदह्ना कुरुते धर्मं प्रजा धर्मेण पालयन्। दशवर्षसहस्राणि तस्य भुक्ते फलं दिवि॥
en: The merit, of a king by protecting his subjects righteously for a single day, is such that he enjoys its reward in heaven for ten thousand years.

sa: युधिष्ठिर उवाच क्लिश्यमानेषु भूतेषु तैस्तै वैस्ततस्ततः। दुर्गाण्यतितरेद् येन तन्मे ब्रूहि पितामह॥
en: Yudhishthira said Creatures are seen to be assailed various means and almost continually. Tell me, O grandfather, in what way can one get over all those difficulties!

sa: विधानं दैवविहितं तत्र विद्वान् न मुह्यति। यथा सृष्टोऽसि राजेन्द्र तथा भवितुमर्हसि॥
en: This has been ordained by the celestials. The learned man, therefore, is never stupefied at it. You should, O great king, become what you are by birth!

sa: रक्ष दुर्योधनात्मानमात्मा सर्वस्य भाजनम्। भिन्ने हि भाजने तात दिशो गच्छति तद्गतम्॥
en: Preserve your own self now, for self in the stay of everything. If the support is broken, O sire, everything attached thereto is scattered on every side.

sa: अथास्य सशरं चापं मुष्टौ चिच्छेद मारिष। हयांश्च चतुरः संख्ये प्रेषयामास मृत्यवे॥
en: Then O king, he cut off at the handle the bow, with arrow fixed on it, of Satyaki and then killed the four horses of the latter.

sa: मृत्योस्तु दुहिता राजन् सुनीथा नाम मानसी। प्रख्याता त्रिषु लोकेषु यासौ वेनमजीजनत्॥
en: Mrityu, O king, had a mind-begotten daughter named Sunitha well-known over the three worlds. She was married to Atibala and gave birth to a son named Vena.

sa: जातिश्रेण्यधिवासानां कुलधर्मांश्च सर्वतः। वर्जयन्ति च ये धर्मं तेषां धर्मो न विद्यते॥
en: There is no expiation for them who do not observe duties and practices of their order and caste, country, and family, and who forsake their own creed.

sa: ये चाप्यत्र सहायाः स्युः पार्थिवानां युधिष्ठिर। ते चैवांशहराः सर्वे धर्मे परकृतेऽनघ॥
en: Those men also, O Yudhishthira, who assist kings (in protecting their subjects), are equally entitled, O sinless one, to a share of the merits acquired by others.

sa: आर्यामार्य सुभद्रां त्वमिमांश्च त्रिदशोपमान्। पितॄन् मां चैव दुःखार्ता विहाय क्व गमिष्यसि॥
en: Where will you go, leaving behind you the much-respected Subhadra, these your sires who take after the very celestials, and my own wretched self distracted with grief.

sa: एतानि यस्य गुप्तानि स राजा राजसत्तमः। सततं वर्तमानोऽत्र राजा धत्ते महीमिमाम्॥
en: That king who takes proper care of these is considered to be the best of kings. By always doing these, a king succeeds in protecting his kingdom.

sa: दृष्ट्वा सर्वाणि सैन्यानि नाध्यवस्यंस्तयोर्जयम्। हत्वा मद्राधिपं पार्थो भोक्ष्यतेऽद्य वसुन्धराम्॥ शल्यो वा पाण्डवं हत्वा दद्याद् दुर्योधनाय गाम्। इतीव निश्चयो नाभूद् योधानां तत्र भारत॥
en: Beholding them both, the soldiers could not decide which of them would win. Whether the son of Pritha would enjoy the Earth, having killed the king of the Madras or, Shalya, having slain the son of Pandu, would bestow the Earth on Duryodhana, could not be decided, O Bharata, by the warriors present there.

sa: आददानस्य चेद् राज्यं ये केचित् परिपन्थिनः। हन्तव्यास्त इति प्राज्ञाः क्षत्रधर्मविदो विदुः॥
en: Wise men conversant with Kshatriya duties have said that they who stand in the way of the person taking the sovereignty of the Earth, should be killed.

sa: य एष ते सुतो राजन् लोकसंहारकारणात्॥ कलेरंशः समुत्पन्नो गान्धार्या जठरे नृप।
en: From this you should know, O king that your son Duryodhana, born in Gandhari's womb, was a portion of Kali born for bringing about a universal slaughter.

sa: कृते कर्मणि राजेन्द्र पूजयेद् धनसंचयैः। दानेन च यथार्हेण सान्त्वेन विविधेन च॥
en: Whenever any of his work is done the king should reward those who have helped in its accomplishment with wealth and other becoming presents and grateful speeches.

sa: मा स्माधर्मेण लोभेन लिप्सेथास्त्वं धनागमम्। धर्मार्थावध्रुवौ तस्य यो न शास्त्रपरो भवेत्॥
en: Never desire to fill your treasury by acting unfairly or from covetousness. That king who does not follow the scriptures fails to acquire riches and religious merit.

sa: यस्तु रञ्जयते राजा पौरजानपदान् गुणैः। न तस्य भ्रमते राज्यं स्वयं धर्मानुपालनात्॥
en: That king who pleases the inhabitants of his cities and provinces by means of his virtues, is never divested of his kingdom for observing such a duty.

sa: ईश्वरः पुरुषः प्राणः सत्त्वं चित्तं प्रजापतिः। भूतात्मा जीव इत्येवं नामभिः प्रोच्यतेऽष्टभिः॥
en: Punishment has again these other eight names, viz., God, Men, Life, Power, Heart, the Lord of all creatures, the Soul of all things, and the Living creature.

sa: सत्यनित्यः क्षमानित्यो ज्ञाननित्योऽतिथिप्रियः। यो ददाति सतां नित्यं स मां पृच्छतु पाण्डवः॥
en: Let the son of Pandu, who is ever truthful, forgiving, endued with knowledge, and attentive to guests and who always makes gifts to the pious, question me.

sa: कच्चित् कृषिकरा राष्ट्रं न जहेत्यतिपीडिताः। ये वहन्ति धुरं राज्ञां ते भरन्तीतरानपि॥
en: Let not the agriculturists in your kingdom leave it through oppression; they, who bear the burden of the king, support the other residents also of the kingdom.

sa: अभिप्रयातां समितिं ज्ञात्वा ये प्रतियान्त्यथ। तेषां स्यन्दन्ति गात्राणि योधानां विजयस्य च।॥
en: Having determined that a battle is raging, the limbs of those that go to join it, as also of him that is conquering, are covered with perspiration.

sa: तस्मिन्नपरिहार्येऽर्थे व्यतीते च विशेषतः॥ माशुचो न हि शोच्यास्ते संग्रामे निधनं गताः।
en: Do not, therefore, grieve in a matter that was inevitable, especially when it has taken place! Having been dead in battle they should not be grieved for!

sa: तदाप्रभृति बीभत्सुं न शक्नोमि निरीक्षितुम्॥ कृष्णं च पुण्डरीकाक्षं किल्बिषी भ्रूणहा यथा।
en: I am guilty of infanticide. Sinful as I am, I have not, since then, been able to look at the face of Arjuna or the lotus-eyed Krishna.

sa: न चैव पुरुषो द्रष्टा स्वर्गस्य नरकस्य च। आगमस्तु सतां चक्षुर्नृपते तमिहाचर॥
en: No person can see either heaven or hell. The sacred books, however, are the eyes of the virtuous. O king, regulate your conduct according to the scriptures.

sa: ततः प्रीतोऽभवद् राजा प्रह्लादो ब्रह्मवादिनः। तथेत्युक्त्वा शुभे काले ज्ञानतत्त्वं ददौ तदा॥
en: At this answer, king Prahlada became pleased with that Brahmavadin. Saying,-So be it!-he availed of a favourable opportunity for delivering to the Brahma the truths of knowledge.

sa: बाणान् विनिशितान् पीतान् निस्त्रिंशान् विमला गदाः। युद्धाभिमानिनः सर्वे जीवन्त इव बिभ्रति॥
en: Those heroes, look even cheerful, now, and have still beside them their keen arrows, welltempered swords, and bright maces, as if life has not yet left them!

sa: अथवा ते घृणा काचित् प्रायश्चित्तं चरिष्यसि। मा त्वेवानार्यजुष्टेन मन्युना निधनं गमः॥
en: Or, if despite it, you still consider yourself sinful, perform expiation. Do not cast away your life for such grief that does not become a wise man.'

sa: तेषां पुत्राश्च पौत्राश्च येषां वंशाः प्रतिष्ठिताः। एवमेतत् पुरावृत्तं यन्मां पृच्छसि पाण्डव॥
en: Those Kshatriya races that are now in existence the offsprings of those princes.-What you have questioned me son of Pandu, thus took place in days of yore.

sa: ऋषभ उवाच सत्यमेतन्न संदेहो यदेतद् व्याहृतं त्वया। ततः प्रहस्य भगवांस्तनुर्धर्मभृतां वरः॥
en: Rishabha continued The holy Tanu, that best of virtuous persons, smiling, caused, by virtue of his learning and his penances, the king's son to be brought there.

sa: अहो धन्यो नृलोकोऽयं सभाग्याश्च नरा भुवि। यत्र कर्मेदृशं धर्म्यं द्विजेन कृतमित्युत॥
en: Indeed, Praiseworthy is this world of men and fortunate are they that live in it where such a wonderful but righteous deed was performed by a Brahinana.

sa: तेनेयं पृथिवी दुग्धा सस्यानि दश सप्त च। यक्षराक्षसनागैश्चापीप्सितं यस्य यस्य यत्॥
en: He drew from the Earth, as a milcher from a COW, seventeen sorts of crops for the food of Yakshas, and Rakshasas, and Nagas, and other creatures.

sa: मुमोच निशितान् बाणान् पुत्राणां तव मर्मसु। ते कीर्यमाणा भीमेन पुत्रास्तव महारणे॥
en: Those sons of yours, covered with arrows by Bhimasena in that dreadful encounter, began to drag that warrior like men dragging an elephant from the crossing point.

sa: पूर्वशास्त्रविदोऽप्येवं जनाः पश्यन्ति भारत। क्रियासु निरता नित्यं दाने यज्ञे च कर्मणि॥
en: Men of olden times who were conversant with the scriptures, O Bharata,-men who were always engaged in gifts and sacrifices and action, held this view, O Bharata.

sa: राजा कृतयुगस्रष्टा त्रेताया द्वापरस्य च। युगस्य च चतुर्थस्य राजा भवति कारणम्॥
en: The king is the creator of the Krita age, of the Treta, and of the Dvapara. The king is the creator of the fourth age (called Kali).

sa: यथा हि गर्भिणी हित्वा स्वं प्रियं मनसोऽनुगम्। गर्भस्य हितमाधत्ते तथा राज्ञाप्यसंशयम्॥
en: As the mother, even not caring for those objects which she likes best, seeks the wellbeing of her child alone, so, forsooth, should kings treat their subjects.

sa: गदायुद्धे न मे कश्चित् सदृशोऽस्तीति चिन्तये। गदया वो हनिष्यामि सर्वानेव समागतान्॥
en: I think there is none who can equal me in an encounter with the mace. With my mace I shall kill all of you one after another.

sa: इदं चित्रमिदं घोरमिदं रौद्रमिति प्रभो। युद्धान्यासन् महाराज घोराणि च बहूनि च॥
en: Here an encounter was beautiful, there another was dicadful and there another was exceedingly fierce. O lord, many dreadful encounters took place in course of that battle.

sa: संकटद्वारकाणि स्युरुच्छ्वासार्थं पुरस्य च। तेषां च द्वारवद् गुप्तिः कार्या सर्वात्मना भवेत्॥
en: He should keep small outlets in his walls for firing guns from his fort, and carefully make arrangements for their defence like that of the greater gates.

sa: श्रीभगवानुवाच अमोघः परमास्त्रस्य पातस्तस्य भविष्यति। स तु गर्भो मृतो जातो दीर्घमायुरवाप्स्यति॥
en: Krishna said The fall of this mighty weapon will not be useless. The foetus will die. But being dead, it will revive and have a long life.

sa: योऽयं मूर्धाभिषिक्तानामग्रे यातः परंतपः। स हतो ग्रसते पांसून् पश्य कालस्य पर्ययम्॥
en: Witness the misfortunes brought about Time! This destroyer of enemies who used to walk at the head of all crowned kings, is now। covered with the dust.

sa: एवं स कृत्वा समयं दृष्ट्वा नीहारमीश्वरः॥ चिच्छेदास्य शिरो राजन्नपां फेनेन वासवः।
en: Having made this understanding, the lord Indra one day behold a fog. He then, O king, sundered Namuchi's head, using the foam of water as his weapon.

sa: दत्त्वा दानं द्विजातिभ्यो रजनी तामुपोष्य च। पूजितो मुनिसद्धैश्च प्रातरुत्थाय लागली॥ अनुज्ञाप्य मुनीन् सर्वान् स्पृष्ट्वा तोयं च भारत। प्रययौ त्वरितो रामस्तीर्थहेतोर्महावलः॥
en: Having distributed wealth amongst the Brahmanas and passed the night there the hero, having the plough for his weapon, was adored by the ascetics. Rising up in the morning, he took leave of all the ascetics and having touched the sacred water, O Bharata, started quickly for other tirthas.

sa: तथास्य दृश्यते चेष्टा नीतिश्चैव विशाम्पते। नैष दास्यति नो राज्यमिति मे मतिरच्युत॥
en: The great Vidura, O sire, told me many a time that as long as Duryodhana would live, he would never give us our share of the kingdom.

sa: न दुःखं परदुःखे वै केचिदाहुरबुद्धयः। यो दुःखं नाभिजानाति स जल्पति महाजने॥
en: Some foolish persons say that there is no misery in seeing other's misery. Only he wno has not felt any misery himself can say so before men.

sa: यान् सुपर्णाश्च गृध्राश्च विकर्षन्ति यतस्ततः। तेषां तु कर्मणा लोका भविष्यन्ति युधिष्ठिर॥
en: O Yudhishthira, will they obtain blissful regions by the merit of their deeds, they whose bodies are now being torn and dragged by vultures and other birds?'

sa: ततः समभवत् सैन्यं संसक्तं तत्र तत्र हा तावकानां परेषां च संग्रामेष्वनिविर्तनाम्॥
en: Again an encounter took place between those pairs as they stood, among your warriors and those of the enemy, none of whom had ever retreated from fight.

sa: चेष्टामकुर्वल्लभते यदि किंचिद् यदृच्छया। यो वा न लभते कृत्वा दुर्दर्शी तावुभावपि॥
en: There is hardly seen a person who obtains something of itself without haying made any exertion, as also one who does not obtain anything even after exertion.

sa: महाभाग्यं पुरा राज्ञां कीर्त्यमानं मया शृणु॥ गच्छावधानं नृपते ततो दुःखं प्रहास्यसि।
en: Listen to me as I describe the great bliss of (some) ancient kings. Hear me with rapt attention. You will then O king, cast off your sorrow.

sa: अत स्थितानां पाण्डूनां दीनानां भरतर्षभ। तस्माद् देशादपक्रम्य त्वरिता लुब्धका विभो॥ आजग्मुः शिबिरं हृष्टा दृष्ट्वा दुर्योधनं नृपम्। वार्यमाणाः प्रविष्टाश्च भीमसेनस्य पश्यतः॥
en: While the Pandavas, O best of Bharata's race, were thus disappointed those hunters, O lord, came speedily from the banks of that lake and arrived at the camp filled with joy at having found out Duryodhana. Though forbidden, they still entered the camp, before the very presence of Bhimasena.

sa: मूढांस्तु सर्वथा मन्ये धार्तराष्ट्रान् सुबाललिशान्। पतिते शान्तनोः पुत्रे येऽकार्षुः संयुगं पुनः॥
en: I regard the son of Dhritarashtra as foolish and of weak understanding by every means since they continued the battle even after the fall of Shantanu's son.

sa: तत्र देवाः सगन्धर्वाः प्रीता यज्ञस्य सम्पदा। विस्मिता मानुषाश्चासन् दृष्ट्वा तां यज्ञसम्पदम्॥
en: The gods and the Gandharvas were all pleased with the numberless articles in that sacrifice. As regards men they were filled with wonder on seeing those articles.

sa: इदमन्यत् तु भगवन् यत् त्वां वक्ष्यामि नारद। मन्त्रसंवरणेनास्मि कुन्त्या दुःखेन योजितः॥
en: There is another subject, O holy Narada, about which I will speak to you. For Kunti having hidden a very important matter, great has been my grief.

sa: अवश्यमेव योद्धव्यं सर्वेरेव मया सह। युक्तं त्वयुक्तमित्येतद् वेत्सि त्वं चैव सर्वदा॥
en: I shall forsooth fight all of you. You will act as a judge, as you have the necessary qualifications for judging the propriety and impropriety of everything.

sa: एते चान्ये च बहवो निहतास्त्वत्कृते नृपाः। त्वामद्य निहनिष्यामि गदया नात्र संशयः॥
en: These and many other kings have been killed through your fault! I shall kill you to-day with my mace! There is not the least doubt about it!'

sa: अरण्ये वसतां तात भ्रातृणां ते मनस्विनाम्। मनोरथा महाराज ये तत्रासन् युधिष्ठिर॥ तानिमे भरतश्रेष्ठ प्राप्नुवन्तु महारथाः। प्रशाधि पृथिवीं पार्थ ययातिरिव नाहुषः॥
en: Let these great car-warriors, possessing sufficient mental strength, O king, let these your brothers, O Yudhishthira the chief of the Bharatas, satisfying those wishes of theirs which they entertained while living in the woods. Rule you the Earth, O son of Pritha, like (another) Yayati the son of Nahusha.

sa: पुरूरवा उवाच कुत:स्विद् ब्राह्मणो जातो वर्णाश्चापि कुतस्त्रयः। कस्माच्च भवति श्रेष्ठस्तन्मे व्याख्यातुमर्हसि॥
en: Pururavas said Whence has the Brahmana originated and whence the three other orders? Why also has the Brahmana become the foremost? You should tell me all this.

sa: प्रहादेन हृतं राज्यं महेन्द्रस्य महात्मनः। शीलमाश्रित्या दैत्येन त्रैलोक्यं च वशे कृतम्॥
en: In days of yore, the Daitya Prahlada, by the merit of his conduct, snatched from the great Indra his sovereignty and brought the three worlds under subjection.

sa: परेषां प्रतिघातार्थं पदातीनां च बृंहणम्। अपि तस्मिन् पुरे वृद्धा भवेयुर्ये पुरोगमाः॥
en: This should be the arrangement for attacking the enemy. The veterans of the army should fight in the van. They would protect their comrades in the rear.

sa: तं पुत्रगृद्धिनी भूयो माता पुत्रमथाब्रवीत्॥ भ्रातृणां स्वस्ति कुर्वीथा येषां स्वस्ति चिकीर्षसि।
en: Seeking the well-being of her children, his mother once more said to him,-'Go, O Karna, do good to those brothers of yours whose good you always seek.'

sa: अविनाशोऽस्य सत्त्वस्य नियतो यदि भारत। हत्वा शरीरं भूतानां न हिंसा प्रतिपत्स्यते॥
en: If this being, O Bharata, which is called soul, is not subject to destruction, then by destroying the bodies of creatures one cannot be guilty of murder.

sa: योऽत्यन्तं प्रतिगृह्णीयाद् यश्च दद्यात् सदैव हि। तयोस्त्वमन्तरं विद्धि श्रेयांस्ताभ्यां क उच्यते॥
en: One always accepts gifts from others, while another always makes gifts. You know the difference between the two, Who, indeed, of these two should be considered superior?

sa: सुयोधनमिमं भग्नं हतसैन्यं ह्रदं गतम्। पराजितं वनप्रेप्सुं निराशं राज्यलम्भने॥ को न्वेष संयुगे प्राज्ञः पुनर्द्वन्द्वे समाह्वयेत्। अपि नो निर्जितं राज्यं न हरेत सुयोधनः॥
en: This Suyodhana had been routed and fled. All his troops had been slain. He had entered the lake. He had been defeated, and, therefore, he had wished to retire into forest, having given up all hope of retaining his kingdom. What wise man is there, that would challenge such a person to a single-combat?

sa: न तत् ऋतुसहस्रेण नोपवासैश्च नित्यशः। अभयस्य च दानेन यत् फलं प्राप्नुयान्नरः॥
en: The fruit that one reaps by giving as assurance to all creatures of his harmlessness cannot be obtained by celebrating a thousand sacrifices or by daily fasts.

sa: कच्चित् कुन्ती च राजंस्त्वां शुश्रूषत्यनहंकृता। या परित्यज्य स्वं पुत्रं गुरुशुश्रूषणे रता॥
en: Does Kunti, o king, who for her devotion to the service of her seniors, left her children, attend to your wants and serve your with all humility?

sa: राज्यलुब्धः पुनः कर्ण समाव्यथसि पाण्डवान्। यदा शकुनिमाश्रित्य क्क ते धर्मस्तदा गतः॥
en: When thirsting for the kingdom and relying on the king of Gandharas you invited the Pandavas to a game at dice where was this virtue of yours?

sa: मनो नवममेषां तु बुद्धिस्तु दशमी स्मृता॥ एकादशस्त्वनन्तात्मा स सर्वः पर उच्यते।
en: The mind is the ninth, and the understanding is the tenth. The Soul, which is infinite, is the eleventh. It is considered as the highest of all.

sa: आकाशं मारुतो ज्योतिरापः पृथ्वी च पञ्चमी। भावाभावौ च कालश्च सर्वभूतेषु पञ्चसु॥
en: Ether, wind, light, water, and earth as the fifth, and existence and non-existence and time, exist in all living creatures having the five for their component ingredients.

sa: तस्य बुद्धिरियं ह्यासीद् धर्मनित्यस्य भारत। इयं सरस्वती तूर्णं मत्समीपं तपोधनम्॥ आनयिष्यति वेगेन वसिष्ठं तपतां वरम्। इहागतं द्विजश्रेष्ठं हनिष्यामि न संशयः॥
en: Thought devoted to the performance of his duties, O Bharata, he formed the resolution, viz., This Sarasvati shall speedily bring, by force of her current, that foremost of ascetics, viz., Vashishtha, to my presence. After he shall have been brought hither, I shall forsooth kill that greatest of ascetics.

sa: तस्माद् गुणेषु रज्येथा मा दोषेषु कदाचन। अनित्यमिह मानां जीवितं हि चलाचलम्॥
en: Therefore, one should also attach him to all good qualities but never to bad qualities. The life of human beings in this world is fickle and transitory.

sa: नारद उवाच गालवं वैनतेयोऽथ प्रहसन्निदमब्रवीत्। दिष्ट्या कृतार्थं पश्यामि भवन्तमिह वै द्विज।।।।
en: Narada said The son of Vinata, seeing Galava, said to him thus laughing. “It is by good luck that I see you successful here, O twice-born one".

sa: व्यास उवाच गृहस्थस्तु यदा पश्येद् वलीपलितमात्मनः। अपत्यस्यैव चापत्यं वनमेव तदा श्रयेत्॥
en: Vyasa said When the householder sees his body wrinkled and hair white on his head, and children of his children, he should then retire into the forest.

sa: वैशम्पायन उवाच इत्युक्तो धर्मराजेन तदा शान्तनवो नृपः। सम्यगाह गुणांस्तस्मै गोप्रदानस्य केवलान्॥
en: Vaishampayana said Thus accosted by king Yudhishthira the just, Shantanu's son began to describe to him once again, in full, the merits of the gift of kine.

sa: एवमुक्त्वा ततः पार्थ विसृज्य च महाबलः॥ न्यहनत् पाण्डवीं सेनां वज्रहस्त इवासुरीम्।
en: Having said this and left off the son of Pritha the highly powerful Karna began to slay Pandava like the holder of thunder-bolt, the army of Asuras.

sa: तस्य दर्शनतृष्णं मां सानुजं वनमास्थितम्। याज्ञसेन्याः परामर्श स च वीर दहत्युत॥
en: With the thirst for seeing him, I live with my younger brothers in the forest. O hero, the great oppression committed on Yajnaseni (Draupadi) also burns me.

sa: यथाप्रतिज्ञं तत् कर्म कृत्वा द्रौणायनिः प्रभो॥ दुर्गमा पदवीं गच्छन् पितुरासीद् गतज्वरः।
en: Having perpetrated that massacre according to his promise, and having trodden that untrodden way, Drona's son, O king, forgot his sorrow for the death of his father.

sa: ततः प्राग्ज्योतिषो राजा शरवर्षे निवार्यत्। शरैर्जघ्ने महाबाहुं पार्थे कृष्णं च मारिष॥
en: Oll car Then, O sire, the king of the Pragjyotisas, baffling that shower of arrows, pierced the mighty-armed son of Pritha, as also Krishna, with his arrows.

sa: अन्यामन्यां धनावस्थां प्राप्य वैशेषिकी नराः। अतृप्ता यान्ति विध्वंसं संतोषं यान्ति पण्डिता॥
en: Men of little understandings, in their efforts to acquire different grades of wealth, lose their contentment and at last die broken-hearted. Wise men, however, are always contented.

sa: उभयोरेव वामर्थे यतिष्ये तव तस्य च। संश्लेषं वा करिष्यामि शाश्वतं पनपायिनम्॥
en: I shall try for the good of you both. I shall create a union, between you and that king, which should be eternal and cannot be broken.

sa: संजय उवाच एतावदुक्त्वा प्रययौ परिदाय युधिष्ठिरम्। धृष्टद्युम्नाय बलवान् सुहद्भ्यश्च पुनः पुनः॥
en: Sanjaya said Having thus spoken, the highly powerful Bhimasena prepared to go having over the charge of protecting Yudhishthira to Dhrishtadyumna and other friends of the Pandavas.

sa: त्वं हि राज्यविनाशं न द्विषद्भिश्चनिराक्रियाम्। क्लेशांश्च विविधान् कृष्ण सर्वांस्तानपि वेद नः॥
en: You, () Krishna, know all about the despoliation of our kingdom, our exile by the that, my enemy and also all the miseries we had to suffer.

sa: अगृह्णन् बहवो राजशलभान् वायसा इव। तथा गजान् प्रभिन्नांश्च सम्प्रभिन्ना महागजाः॥ तस्मिन्नेव पदे यत्ता निगृह्णन्ति स्म भारत। सादी सादिनपासाद्य पत्तयश्च पदातिनम्॥
en: And, O king, attacked numerous (other carwarriors), as crows (attack) winged insects. In the same manner, elephants, with the juice trickling down their bodies, resolutely attacked great elephants (of the opposite side) with juice trickling down their bodies, O Bharata. Horsemen approaching horsemen and foot soldiers (approaching) foot soldiers.

sa: त्वं तु प्राकृतया बुद्ध्या पुरन्दर विकत्यसे। यदाहमिव भावी स्यास्तदा नैवं वदिष्यसि॥
en: Guided, however, by a vulgar intelligence, you are bragging, O Purandara. When you will become like me you will not then give vent to speeches like these.'

sa: त्वं तु प्राकृतया बुद्ध्या पुरन्दर विकत्यसे। यदाहमिव भावी स्यास्तदा नैवं वदिष्यसि॥
en: Guided, however, by a vulgar intelligence, you are bragging, O Purandara. When you will become like me you will not then give vent to speeches like these.'

sa: क्लीबस्य हि कुतो राज्यं दीर्घसूत्रस्य वा पुनः। किमर्थं च महीपालानवधीः क्रोधमूर्छितः॥
en: Where on Earth has a eunuch or a procrastinating person acquired sovereignty? Why then did you beside yourself with anger, slay all the kings of the Earth.

sa: प्रज्ञया सदृशश्चासि शुक्रेणाङ्गिरसेन च। विदितं चापि ते सर्वं यथावृत्तः स कौरवः॥
en: Your wisdom is equal to that of Shukra or the son of Angirasa and it is known to you what sort of a man the Kaurava is.

sa: ततो द्रौणिर्धनुस्त्यक्त्वा रथात् प्रस्कन्ध वेगितः। धिग् धिक् सर्वमिदं मिथ्येत्युक्त्वा सम्प्राद्रवद् रणात्।।
en: Then Drona's son throwing aside his bow and leaping down with agility from his car, fled from the field of battle-saying-"O Fie, 0 fie, everything is un-true.

sa: तपसा तदवाप्नोति यद्भूतं सृजते जगत्। स तद्भूतश्च सर्वेषां भूतानां भवति प्रभुः॥
en: By penance one attains to that Being who creates the universe. He who thus succeeds in attaining to that Being becomes the powerful lord of all beings.

sa: प्रदक्षिणां यः कुरुते पृथिवीं तीर्थतत्परः। किं फलं तस्य कात्स्येन तद्भवान् वक्तुमर्हति॥
en: You should tell me in detail what merit is obtained by him who travels over the world with the desire of seeing the Tirthas and sacred shrines.

sa: तथैव च न पश्यामि युधि गाण्डीवधन्वनः। अनिशं चिन्तयानोऽपि य एनमुदियाद् रथी।॥
en: Reflecting day and night I do not see amongst us that warrior who will be able to stand in battle before the wielder of the Gandiva (Arjuna).

sa: प्रकाशकर्मा तपनो योऽयं देवो विरोचनः। अजीजनत् त्वां मय्येष कर्ण शस्त्रभृतां वरम्॥
en: The god Tapana or Virochana (Surya) whose duty it is to make everything visible, begot you on me, O Karna, O you foremost of wielders of weapons.

sa: शिखण्डिनि च मा भैस्त्वं विधास्ये तत्र तत्त्वतः। कृपयाऽहं वरारोहे वञ्चितः पुत्रधर्मतः॥
en: Do you not fear, neither (let) Shikhandin (fear), for I will make suitable arrangements through kindness through I have been deprived from the duties to a son.

sa: बृहदश्व उवाच आसीद् राजा नलो नाम वीसेनसुतो बली। उपपन्नो गुणैरिष्टै रूपवानश्वकोविदः॥
en: Brihadashva said: There was a heroic king, named Nala the son of Virasena. He was possessed of desirable attainments, handsome and well-acquainted with the management of horses.

sa: वासुदेवं पुरस्कृत्य सर्वे ते क्षत्रियर्षभाः। परिवार्योपविविशुर्धर्मराज युधिष्ठिरम्।। अभिवाद्य कुरुश्रेष्ठं विषण्णः केशवोऽब्रवीत्॥
en: All those foremost of Kshatriyas with Vasudeva (Krishna) at their head sat around Dharmaraja Yudhishthira. Saluting that chief of the Kurus, Keshava (Krishna) spoke thus in sorrow.

sa: न लोके राजते मूर्खः केवलात्मप्रशंसया। अपि चेह श्रिया हीनः कृतविद्यः प्रकाशते॥
en: The fool cannot shine in this world only by praising himself. Rather the learned man, even if he be dirty and anointed, shines gloriously in this world.

sa: मृषा वादं परिहरेत् कुर्यात् प्रियमयाचितः। न च कामान्न संरम्भान्न द्वेषाद् धर्ममुत्सृजेत्॥
en: One should do away with falsehood. He should render good to all without being asked. He should never forsake virtue out of lust or anger or malice.

sa: तिर्यग्योनिगतान् सत्त्वान् मा हिंसन्ति मोहिताः। कीटान् पिपीलिकान् सर्पान् मेषान् समृगपक्षिणः।। किल्बिषं सुबहु प्राप्ताः किंस्विदेषां प्रतिक्रिया। ततो देवगणाः सर्वे ऋषयश्च तपोधनाः॥
en: Having heard those mysteries of religion as explained by che Pitris, he addressed Shakra, saying, Stupefied by folly, men kill numerous creatures born in the intermediate orders, such as worms, ants, snakes, sheep, deer and birds. They commit a great sin by these acts. What, however, is the remedy?

sa: मध्यमं तु तदा पत्नी भुङ्क्तेऽनुज्ञातमेव हि॥ किमर्थं पितरस्तस्य कव्यमेव च भुञ्जते।
en: The second ball is eaten by the wife. That has been laid down in the ordinance. How do the Pitris of that man become the eaters thereof?

sa: अत्र यस्त्वन्तिमः पिण्डो गच्छते जातवेदसम्॥ भवते का गतिस्तस्य कं वा समनुगच्छति।
en: The last ball goes into the burning fire. How does that ball succeed in finding its way to you, or who is he to whom it goes?

sa: तमसा निद्रया चैव पुनरेव व्यदीर्यत। द्रोणेन वार्यमाणास्ते स्वयं तव सुतेन च॥
en: (Overcome) with sleep and bewildered by darkness began once more to disperse. In spite of (the endeavours of) Drona and your son himself to prevent (their fight),

sa: क्षुत्पिपासादयो भावा जिता यस्येह देहिनः। क्रोधोलोभस्तथा मोहः सत्त्वन् मुक्त एव सः॥
en: That man of firm Soul, forsooth, liberated who has conquered hunger and thirst and such other states of the body, as also anger and cupidity and error.

sa: अनित्यं यौवनं रूपं जीवितं द्रव्यसंचयः। आरोग्यं प्रियसंवासो गृध्येत् तत्र न पण्डितः॥
en: A wise man should never hanker after youth, beauty, longevity, accumulation of riches, health, and the companionship of those that are dear, all of which are transitory.

sa: ओषध्यः पशवो वृक्षा वीरुदाज्यं पयो दधि। हविर्भूमिर्दिशः श्रद्धा कालश्चैतानि द्वादश॥ ऋचो यजूंषि सामानि यजमानश्च षोडश। अग्नि यो गृहपतिः स सप्तदश उच्यते॥ अङ्गान्येतानि यज्ञस्य यज्ञो मूलमिति श्रुतिः। आज्येन पयसा दधा शकृताऽऽमिक्षया त्वचा॥ वालैः शृङ्गेण पादेन सम्भवत्येव गौमखम्। एवं प्रत्येकशः सर्वं यद् यदस्य विधीयते॥ यज्ञं वहन्ति सम्भूय सहत्विग्भिः सदक्षिणैः। संहृत्यैतानि सर्वाणि यज्ञं निवर्तयन्त्युत॥
en: The deciduous herbs, animals, trees, creepers, clarified butter, milk, curds, meat and other selected things land, the points of the horizon, faith, and time which forms the twelfth, the Richs, the Yajushes, the Samans, and the sacrificer himself froming the sixteenth, and Fire which should be known as the householder, these seventeen are said to be the linbs of Sacrifice. Sacrifice, the Shruti says, is the root of the world and its movement. With clarified butter, milk, curds, dung, curds mixed with milk, skin, the hair in her tail, horns, and hoofs, the cow alone is able to supply all the necessaries of sacrifice. For particular sacrifices are sanctioned particular ones, Ritwijas and presents together sustain Sacrifices. By collecting these things together, people celebrate sacrifices.

sa: आत्मराज्यं धनं चैव कलत्रं वाहनं तथा। यत्तद्भागवतं सर्वमिति तत् प्रोक्षितं सदा॥
en: His kingdom and riches and wives and animals were all considered by him as obtained from Narayana. He, therefore, offered all his belongings to that great god.

sa: रोषस्य हि वशं गत्वा दशग्रीवः प्रतापवान्। तथा शक्रप्रतिस्पर्धी हतो रामेण संयुगे॥
en: By yielding to the influence of anger, the ten-headed Ravan of great prowess, became the rival Shakra and was for that reason killed by Rama in battle.

sa: यम उवाच तपसोऽस्य सुतप्तस्य तथा सुचरितस्य च। फलप्राप्तिस्तव श्रेष्ठा यमोऽहं त्वामुपब्रुवे।॥
en: Yama said I am Yama. I say to you that a high reward awaits you for these well-performed penances of yours and for this your pious conduct.

sa: प्राणत्यागं कुरु मुने गच्छ लोकान् यथेप्सितान्। त्यक्त्वाऽऽत्मनः शरीरं च ततो लोकानवाप्स्यसि॥
en: O ascetic, cast off your vital breaths then, and to go whatever regions you please. By casting off your body you will acquire many regions of felicity.

sa: योऽसौ व्यक्तत्वमापन्नो निर्ममे च पितामहम्। सोऽहंकार इति प्रोक्तः सर्वतेजोमयो हि सः॥
en: It is that Aniruddha who, becoming manifest, created the Grandfather Brahman. Aniruddha is known by another name, viz., consciousness, and is gifted with every sort of energy.

sa: सर्वे सम्भूय सहिता ह्यस्य नागस्य बान्धवाः। भ्रातरस्तनया भार्या ययुस्तं ब्राह्मणं प्रति॥
en: All the kinsmen and relatives of the great Naga, including his brothers and children and wife, assembling together, went to the spot where the Brahmana was living.

sa: एते ते निरयाः प्रोक्ताः सर्व एव यथातथम्। तस्य स्थानवरस्येह सर्वे निरयसंज्ञिता:॥
en: I have not told you of all those regions that are called hell. Indeed, as compared with that foremost of regions all the others are called hell.'

sa: एवं यो वेद कामस्य केवलस्य निवर्तनम्। बन्धं वै कामशास्त्रस्य स दुःखान्यतिवर्तते॥
en: One who understands that the end of all acts performed from the desire of fruit is rebirth or chains that bind, succeeds in getting over all sorrow.

sa: अवबुध्यात्मनाऽऽत्मानं सत्त्वं शील श्रुतं दमम्। अनुक्रोशं च संस्मृत्य त्यज वासमिमं द्विज॥
en: Recollect, O twice-born one, your famous kinsmen of former times, all of whom were well-read in the Vedas. Born in their family, alas, you have sullied it.

sa: तन्मनः कुरुते सख्यं रजसा सह सङ्गतम्। चादाय जनं पौरं रजसे सम्प्रयच्छति॥
en: It is the mind that first becomes united with darkness. Having united itself, it attacks the soul, the understanding, and the senses, and surrenders them to Rajas."

sa: इति तन्मयमेवेदं सर्वं स्थावरजङ्गमम्। सर्गे च प्रलये चैव तस्मिन् निर्दिश्यते तथा॥
en: All this universe of mobile and immobile objects has for its component parts these five elements. Everything, regarding creation and destruction, is referable to this fivefold elements.

sa: यान्येव पुरुषः कुर्वन् सुखैः कालेन युज्यते॥ पुनस्तान्येव कुर्वाणो दुःखै कालेन युज्यते।
en: There are certain acts by doing which one person enjoys happiness in Time's course. By doing those very acts another reaps misery in the course of Time.

sa: मही महीजाः पवनोऽन्तरिक्षं जलौकसश्चैव जलं दिवं च। स्तदुच्यतां मे भगवन् पुराणम्॥
en: Tell me also this old history, viz., whence have the Earth, all earthly objects, wind, sky aquatic animals, water, heaven, and the dwellers of heaven, all originated.

sa: पुराण: शाश्वतो धर्मः सर्वप्राणभृतां समः॥ कालो न परिहार्यश्च न चास्यास्ति व्यतिक्रमः।
en: Ancient eternal and the embodiment of Justice, Time is always equal about all living creatures. Time cannot be shunned and there is no retrogression in its course.

sa: चतुर्विभक्तः पुरुषः स क्रीडति यथेच्छति। एवं स भगवान् स्वेन ज्ञानेन प्रतिबोधितः॥
en: Divided into four parts, (viz., Aniruddha, Pradyumna, Sankarshana, and Vasudeva), He sports as He pleases. That illustrious and divine Lord is such, awakened by His Own knowledge.

sa: भीष्म उवाच महान् धर्मो महाराज शरणागतपालने। अर्हः प्रष्टुं भवांश्चैव प्रश्नं भरतसत्तम॥
en: Bhishma said Great is the merit, O king, in supporting a suppliant. It is worthy of you, O best of the Bharatas, to ask such a question.

sa: न तत्पुरुषकारेण न च दैवेन केनचित्। सुखमेष्यति तत् तस्य यदेवं संयतात्मनः॥
en: The happiness that he fells who has succeeded in controlling his mind and senses is such that its like can never be experienced through exertion or Destiny.

sa: अमात्सर्यं बुधाः प्राहुर्दाने धर्मे च संयमः। अवस्थितेन नित्यं च सत्येनामत्सरी भवेत्॥
en: Devoted to liberality and the performance of all duties are considered by the wise as forming good-will. One gains universal good will by continued devotion to Truth.

sa: अज्ञानाद् ब्राह्यणं हत्वा स्पृष्टो बालवधेन च। वैशम्पायनविप्रर्षिः किं दैवेन न वारितः॥
en: Was not the twiceborn Rishi Vaishampayana too, who killed a Brahmana in ignorance, and was polluted by the slaughter of a child, put down by the gods?

sa: देवताः ब्राह्मणा: सन्तो यक्षा मानुषचारणाः। धार्मिकान् पूजयन्तीह न धनाढ्यान् न कामिनः॥
en: Thë gods, Brahmanas, Yakshas, and all good men and Charanas always adore the virtuous but never the rich given up to the indulgence of their desires. success

sa: भरद्वाज उवाच यदेतच्चातुराश्रम्यं ब्रह्मर्षिविहितं पुरा। तेषां स्वे स्वे समाचारास्तान् मे वक्तुमिहाहसि॥
en: Bharadwaja said You should tell me about the four modes of life that were formerly laid down by Brahman, also the practices enjoined for each of them.

sa: ततो मे सुकृतं कर्म कृतमात्मविशुद्धये। गावौ च कपिले क्रीत्वा वत्सले बहुदोहने॥
en: I then, for my purification, did some good acts. I also bought two Kapila cows with calves, both of which used to give large quantities of milk.

sa: हष्यति क्रुद्ध्यते कोऽत्र शोचत्युद्विजते चकः। इच्छति ध्यायति द्वेष्टि वाचमीरयते च कः॥
en: Who or what then is that which feels joy, becomes angry, or sorry and suffers tribulation? What is that which wishes, thinks, feels hatred and utters words.

sa: येषु येषु च भाण्डेषु भुक्तं वो द्विजसत्तमाः। तान्येवादाय गच्छध्वं स्ववेश्मानीति भारत॥
en: He also said to them, O Bharata, these words—Taking those golden plates, and vessels which you have used for your dinner, go away, O foremost of Brahmanas.

sa: एक दव दमे दोषो द्वितीयो नोपपद्यते। यदेनं क्षमया युक्तमशक्तं मन्यते जनः॥
en: There is only one fault in self-control. No second fault is seen in it. A person who has self-control is considered by men as weak and imbecile.

sa: अथ देवगणं सर्वं सम्भ्रान्तेन्द्रियमानसम्॥ अपश्यद् भगवान् विष्णुः क्षिप्तं सासुरराक्षसम्। किं त्वत्र सुकृतं कार्यं भवेदिति विचिन्तयन्॥ अनामृष्य ततः क्षेपमवैक्षत च पावकिम्।
en: Vishnu saw all the gods and Asuras and Rakshasas to be greatly troubled in mind. He thought of what should be done under the circumstances. Without being able to bear that challenge regarding the hurling of the dart, he directed his eyes towards Skanda, the son of the Fire-god.

sa: सांख्यस्य वक्ता कपिलः परमर्षिः स उच्यते। हिरण्यगर्भो योगस्य वेत्ता नान्यः पुरातनः॥
en: The promulgator of the Sankhya religion is said to be the great Rishi Kapila. The primeval Hiranyagarbha, and none else, is the promulgator of the Yoga system.

sa: ब्राह्मण उवाच बाल्ये यदि स्यादज्ञानान्मया हस्तः प्रसारितः। निवृत्तलक्षणं धर्ममुपासे संहितां जपन्॥
en: Thc Brahmana said In the boyhood I had, through Ignorance, stretched my hand for accepting gifts. Now, however, I recite the Gayatri, observing the duty of abstention.

sa: निन्दाप्रशंसे चात्यर्थं न वदन्ति परस्य ये। न च निन्दाप्रशंसाभ्यां विक्रियन्ते कदाचन॥
en: Such men never indulge in exaggerated speeches, or laud others, or speak ill of them. They are again never influenced by praise and censure showered on them.

sa: तत्प्रसादाच्च कामेभ्यः फलं प्राप्स्यसि पुत्रक॥ जनन्यास्तद् वचः श्रुत्वा तदाप्रभृति शत्रुहन्। प्राञ्जलिः प्रणतो भूत्वा इदमम्बामचोदयम्॥ कोऽयमम्ब महादेवः स कथं च प्रसीदति।
en: Through his favour, O child, you are sure to obtain all such objects of wishes. Hearing those words of my mother, O destroyer of enemies, that day, I joined my hands in respect and bowing to her, said O mother, who is this Mahadeva? How can one please him?

sa: एतद् वाक्यं गुरोः श्रुत्वा शिष्यास्ते हष्टमानसाः। पुनः प्राञ्जलयो भूत्वा प्रणम्य शिरसा गुरुम्॥ ऊचुस्ते सहिता राजन्निदं वचनमुत्तमम्। यदि प्रीत उपाध्यायो धन्याः स्मो मुनिसत्तम॥
en: Hearing this answer of their preceptor, the disciples became filled with joy. Bending their heads once more low to their preceptor, and joining their hands, all of them simultaneously, said, O king, these excellent words: If our preceptor has been gratified with us, then, O best of sages, we are sure to be successful.

sa: एतद् वः सर्वमाख्यातं स्वाध्यायस्य विधिं प्रति। उपकुर्याच्च शिष्याणामेतच्च हृदि वो भवेत्॥
en: I have now told you everything about the way in which the Vedas should be studied and taught. You should treat your disciples thus, remembering these instructions.”

sa: चतुष्पात् सकलो धर्मः सत्यं चैव कृते युगे। नाधर्मेणागमः कश्चित् परस्तस्य प्रवर्तते॥
en: In the Krita age all the duties exist in full, along with Truth. Men of that age never acquired knowledge or object through unrighteous or forbidden means.

sa: सर्वभूतहिते युक्तो न स्म यो द्विषते जनम्। महाह्रद इवाक्षोभ्यः प्रज्ञातृप्तः प्रसीदति॥
en: Devoted to universal benevolence, such a man never feels animosity for any one. Tranquil like a calm ocean, wisdom feels his soul and he is ever cheerful.

sa: अतिथीनां च सर्वेषां प्रेष्याणां स्वजनस्य च। सामान्यं भोजनं भृत्यैः पुरुषस्य प्रशस्यते॥
en: One should make no distinctions between his guests and servants and kinsmen in matters of food. To treat servants equally in this matter is highly spoken of.

sa: सांख्ययोगेन तुल्यो हि धर्म एकान्तसेवितः। नारायणात्मके मोक्षे ततो यान्ति परां गतिम्॥
en: The religion followed by a person who is devoted whole-mindely to to Narayana is considered as similar or equal in merit to the system of the Sankhyas.

sa: प्राणिनां जननं सत्यं सत्यं संततिरेव च। सत्येन वायुरभ्येति सत्येन तपते रविः॥
en: Truth is the origin of creatures. Truth is their progeny. It is by truth that the Wind moves. It is by truth that the Sun gives heat.

sa: एष ते प्रसवो राजन् जगतः सम्प्रकीर्तितः। निखिलेन महाप्राज्ञ किं भूयः श्रोतुमिच्छसि॥
en: Thus, O king, the origin of the universe has been described fully to you. What, O you of great wisdom, do you wish to hear after this.'

sa: प्रेत्य चात्र मनुष्येन्द्र परमं विन्दते सुखम्। दमेन हि समायुक्तो महान्तं धर्ममश्नुते॥
en: Through self-control, O foremost of men, a person enjoys the highest happiness both in this world and in the next. Gifted with self-control, one wins great virtue.

sa: दारुणोत्पातसंचारो नभसः स्तनयित्नुमान्। पञ्चमः स महावेगो विवहो नाम मारुतः॥ येन वेगवता रुग्णा रूक्षेण रुवता नगान्। वायुना सहिता मेघास्ते भवन्ति बलाहकाः॥
en: That wind causes portends of many sorts and creates roaring sounds in the sky. It is known by the name of Vivaha. The fifth wind has great force and speed. It is dry and roots out and breaks down all trees. Existing with it, the clouds are called Valahaka.

sa: न हर्तव्यं विप्रधनं क्षन्तव्यं तेषु नित्यशः। बालाश्च नावमन्तव्या दरिद्राः कृपणा अपि॥
en: The property of a Brahmana should never be taken. They should always be let alone. Poor, or miserly, or young in years, they should never be dishonored.

sa: ततः प्रणम्य वरदं देवं देवीमुमां तथा। उशना प्राप तद्धीमान् गतिमिष्टां महामुनिः॥
en: Bowing to the boon-giving Mahadeva and also to his wife the goddess Uma, the great ascetic Ushanas, gifted with superior intelligence, proceeded to the place he chose.

sa: अश्विनौ तु स्मृतौ शूद्रौ तपस्युगे समास्थितौ। स्मृतास्त्वङ्गिरसो देवा ब्राह्मणा इति निश्चयः॥
en: The two Ashvins, practising severe penances, have been said to be Shudras. The deities sprung from Angirasa's family have been said to be Brahmanas. This is certain.

sa: को राज्यमभिपद्येत प्राप्य चोपशमं लभेत्। ममेदमिति यच्चेदं पुरं राष्ट्रं च मन्यसे।१५५॥
en: Who is there that would like to obtain sovereignty, or having acquired sovereignty can hope to acquire tranquillity? You know this kingdom and this palace as yours.

sa: अपृथग्दर्शनाः सर्वे ऋक्सामसु यजुःषु च। कामद्वेषौ पृथक् कृत्वा तपः कृत उपासते॥
en: In that age all men consider the Richs, the Samans, and the Yajushes as Identical, despite their seeming diversity. Analysing desire and hatred, they adore only penance.

sa: न तत्र संविभज्यते स्वकर्मणा परस्परम्। तथा कृतं स्वकर्मजं तदेव भुज्यते फलम्॥
en: There one has not to share his deeds with others, but every one enjoys or suffers the fruits of those acts which every one has himself performed.

sa: प्रत्यक्षं तु कुरुश्रेष्ठ त्यज लोभमिहात्मना। त्यक्त्वा लोभं सुखं लोके प्रेत्य चानुचरिष्यसि॥
en: Do you before all persons, avoid covetousness by a strong determination, O Kuru chief. Avoiding covetousness you will acquire happiness both here and in the next world.

sa: वनस्पतीनोषधीयश्च फलं मूलं च ते विदुः॥ न चैतानृत्विजो लुब्धा याजयन्ति फलार्थिनः।
en: These men consider trees, herbs, fruits and roots as the only sacrificial offerings. Greedy priests who seek riches, never officiate at the sacrifices of these (poor) inen.

sa: युधिष्ठिर उवाच कान् स्वगात्रोद्भवान् दोषान् पश्यस्यमितविक्रम्। एतन्मे संशयं कृत्स्नं वक्तुमर्हसि तत्त्वतः॥
en: Yudhishthira said O you of immeasurable energy, what are those faults which you see in one's body? You should explain this doubt to me fully and truly.

sa: विमृश्य तस्मात् प्राज्ञेन वक्तव्यं धर्ममिच्छता। सत्यानृतेन हि कृत उपदेशो हिनस्ति हि॥
en: The wise man, therefore, who wishes to acquire merit, should always act with wisdom. That instruction which is given in exchange for money always sullies the instructor.

sa: पश्च पश्चालवीराणां रथान् दश च पञ्च च। शाश्वसूतध्वजान् कर्णः शरैर्निन्ये यमक्षयम्॥
en: Then Karna led to the abode of Death twenty car-warriors against the Panchala heroes, along with their horses, drivers and standards, by means of his innumerable arrows.

sa: एवमुक्तौ ययौ शीघ्रं पुत्रेण तव सौबलः। पिप्रीषुस्ते सुतान् राजन् दिधक्षुश्चैव पाण्डवान्॥
en: Thus spoken to by your son, the son of Subala, desirous of doing your son good, marched quickly, O king, for the purpose of destroying the Pandavas.

sa: कर्ण कर्ण वृथादृष्टे सूतपुत्रात्मसंस्तुत। अधर्मबुद्धे शृणु मे यत् त्वां वक्ष्यामि साम्प्रतम्॥
en: "O Karna, O son of a charioteer, you are of false sight, you praise your ownself, you are of wicked intelligence. Hear what I tell you now.

sa: कृष्ण दिष्ट्या मम प्रीतिमहती प्रतिपादिता। त्वया गुप्तेन गोविन्द जता पापं जयद्रथम्॥
en: Who have you, that are the lord of all the words, for their protector, O slayer of Madhu. Govinda, through your favour we will conquer our enemies.

sa: स्थितः सर्वात्मना नित्यं प्रियेषु च हितेषु च। त्वां चैवास्माभिराश्रित्य कृतः शस्रसमुद्यमः॥
en: Everything is certain in the case of those who are in your good grace, O bestower of honours. Neither do they incur sin nor meet with reverses.

sa: यस्य चक्रे स्वयं विष्णुः सारथ्यं जगतः प्रभुः। मनस्वी बलवाञ्शूरः कृतास्त्रोऽथ तपोधनः॥
en: Partha has the master of the world Vishnu himself as his driver besides he is a hero, is very powerful and is virtuous at the same time.

sa: रक्षितस्तव पुत्रैश्च क्रोधमूलो हुताशनः। य इमां पृथिवीं राजन् दग्धुं सर्वां समुद्यतः॥
en: And kept up by your sons, the fire of wrath of the Pandavas, O king, was then in full blaze in order to consume the whole world.

sa: ईषादन्तान् सप्तशतान् दासीदासशतानि च। ददतो द्विजमुख्यो मे प्रसादं न चकार सः॥
en: I then offered him seven hundred elephants of huge tusks and many hundreds of male and female slaves. And still that best of Brahmanas was not satisfied.

sa: त्रिशूलमाश्रित्य सुतीक्ष्णधारं सर्वाणि गात्राणि विघर्षसि त्वम्। सुतीक्ष्णधारोपमकर्मणा त्वं युयुत्ससे योऽर्जुनेनाद्य कर्ण॥
en: By desiring to fight, O Karna, today with Arjuna of illustrious feats, you have addressed yourself to rule your body against the keen edges of a trident.

sa: हतशेषस्य भीष्मेण द्रोणेन च महात्मना। अर्धं निहत्य सैन्यस्य कर्णो वैकर्तनो हतः॥
en: Having slain the half of the troops, that had survived the slaughter by the high-souled Bhishma and Drona, Karna, the son of Vikartana, was at last killed.

sa: एवं कृत्वाब्रवीत् पार्थो वासुदेव धनंजयः। याहि संशप्तकान् कृष्ण कार्यमेतत् परं मम॥
en: Subsequent to exhibit such valour, Dhananjaya, the son of Kunti said to Sri Krishna-"Sri Krishna! Move now towards Samsaptakas as it is my prime target this time.

sa: स पूर्वमतिविद्धश्च भृशं पश्चाच पीडितः। ससादाथ च पाञ्चाल्यो व्यपाश्रयत च ध्वजम्॥
en: The Panchala prince had ere this been much wounded and now deeply hierced, he lost all his strength and caught pold of his flag-staff for supporting him.

sa: अथवा शून्यमासीत् तद्येन यातः स सात्यकिः। हतभूयिष्ठमथवा येन यातः स सात्यकिः॥
en: Perhaps the track through which Satyaki passed was empty. Possessed of prowess in the true sense of the term, he alone has crushed numerous hosts, of mine.

sa: दृष्ट्वातु विमुखान् योधान् धृष्टद्युम्नं च पीडितम्। शैनेयोऽचोदयत् तूर्णं रथं द्रौणिरथं प्रति॥
en: Then beholding the troops turning back and Dhristadyumna greatly afflicted, the graidson of Shini, directed his chariot to be driven in haste towards that of Drona's son.

sa: पराक्रमं तु तं दृष्ट्वा तर सूनोर्महारथाः॥ मृत्योरुपान्तिकं प्राप्तौ मादीपुत्रौ स्म मेनिरे।
en: But, on the other hand, beholding the valour of your son all the car-warriors took the twin sons of Madri to be at the point of death.

sa: सा वध्यामाना समरे केकयानां महाचमूः। तमुत्सृज्य रणे शत्रु प्रदुद्राव दिशो दश॥
en: That vast force of the Kaikeyas, being slaughtered in battle, left that enemy in the field and ran away in the ten different directions of the horizon.

sa: ते क्षिप्ता भीमसेनेन शरा भारत भारतान्। विदार्य खं समुत्पेतुः स्वर्णपुङ्खाः शिलाशिताः॥
en: Those shafts furnished with golden wings and whetted on stone shot by Bhimasena, O Bharata, penetrating through the body of the Bharata princes, flew through the sky.

sa: रथमन्यं समारुह्य व्यूहद्वारं ययौ पुनः॥ तमायान्तं तथा दृष्ट्वा भग्नोत्साहं गुरुं तदा।
en: Mounted on another car, an flew towards the gate of the array and at that time, his driver urged his steeds to the top of their speed.

sa: अर्जुन उवाच उद्यम्यात्मानमुग्राय कर्मणे वीर्यमास्थिताः॥ धमन्ति कौरवाः शङ्खान् यस्य वीर्यं समाश्रिताः!
en: Arjuna said He depending upon whose prowess the Kauravas, having addressed themselves to the accomplishment of ficrce deeds, are blowing their conches and facing us with firmness.

sa: जलेन क्लेदयन्यन्ये विमुच्य कवचान्यपि। अवस्थां तादृशीं प्राप्य हते द्रोणे द्रुतं बलम्॥
en: After the slaughter of Drona, the enemy's host, falling into great distress, fled away in haste. Who hath rallied it now? Tell me if you know it.

sa: हयाश्च पर्यधावन्त मुक्तयोक्त्रास्ततस्ततः। तद् दृष्ट्वा कर्म पार्थस्य द्रौणिराहवशोभिनः॥ अर्जुनं जयतां श्रेष्ठं त्वरितोऽभ्येत्य वीर्यवान्। विधुन्बानो महचापं कार्तस्वरविभूषितम्॥ अवाकिरत्ततो द्रौणिः समन्तान्निशितैः शरैः।
en: And the horses, with their trappings destroyed ran about hither and thither. Witnessing these feats of Partha, beautifying the battle-field the powerful son of Drona speedily encountered that foremost of the victorious, quivered his his dreadful, gold bedecked bow and struck him on all sides with innumerable sharpened arrows.

sa: स शरैः क्षतसर्वाङ्गः सात्यकिः सत्यविक्रमः। रराज समरे राजन् सपुष्प इव किंशुकः॥
en: O king, Satyaki, of true prowess, being thus wounded with the arrows in all his limbs, shone in the field of battle like a Kinshuka with flowers.

sa: ते तु नामाङ्किता बाणा द्रोणेनास्ताः शिलाशिताः। नरान् नागान् हयांश्चैवनिजघ्नुः शतशो मृधे॥
en: Shot by Drona, those arrows with his name engraved on them and whetted on stone, began to dispatch men, elephants and horses by hundreds in that battle.

sa: प्रशंसन्ति तदा देवाः सिद्धाश्च परमर्षयः। साधु द्रौणे महाबाहो साधु भीमेति चाब्रुवन्॥
en: Then the celestials, the Siddhas and the high-class sages (the Rishis) praised them both and uttered these words 'Excellent, O powerful-armed son of Drona! Most remarkable,O Bhima!

sa: स त्वया पुरुषव्याघ्र कथं युद्धे निषूदितः। तन्ममाचक्ष्व कौन्तेय यथा कर्णो हतस्त्वया॥
en: How have you then, O most powerful of men, killed him in battle? Describe to me, O son of Kunti, how Karna has been slain by you.

sa: स निर्भिद्य भुजं सव्यं माधवस्य महात्मनः। अयस्मयो हेमदण्डो जगान् धरणीं तदा॥
en: Then that lance, that was made of iron, with a golden rod, after having penetrated through the left arm of that lofty-minded Madhava, went into the earth.

sa: सत्यवान् हि त्रिलोकेऽस्मिन् भवान् ख्यातो जनाधिय॥ तस्य तद् वचनं श्रुत्वा कृष्णवाक्यप्रचोदितः।
en: O ruler of men, you are well-known in the three words for your truthfulness." Having heard these words of Bhima and influenced by the counsel of Krishna.

sa: नागा हयान् समासाद्य विक्षिपन्तो बहून् रणे। दारयामासुरत्युग्रं तत्र तत्र तदा तदा॥
en: Thereafter the elephants coming before the horses, hurled a large number of them in the battle and deeply pierced them in the different directions of the field.

sa: अर्जुन उवाच द्रोणेनैषा मतिः कृष्ण धार्तराष्ट्र निवेशिता। अभेद्या हि मास्त्राणामेषा कवचधारणा॥
en: । Arjuna said I think, O Krishna, that Drona has donned this armour on Duryodhana. This armour, tied as it has been, in invulnerable by my weapons.

sa: अनुमानाच पश्यामि नास्ति संजय सैन्धवः। युद्धं तु तद् यथावृत्तं तन्ममाचक्ष्व तत्त्वतः॥
en: O Sanjaya, I can imagine even now that the king of the Sindhus no longer lives. Therefore, tell me how in reality did that battle rage then.

sa: एष वैश्वानर इव समिद्धः स्वेन तेजसा॥ शरचापेन्धनो द्रोणः क्षत्रं दहति तेजसा।
en: Yonder stands Drona like a fire swelling with its own energy; indeed with bow and arrows constituting fuel he is consuming all the Kshatriyas with his energy.

sa: जनस्य संनिनादं तु श्रुत्वा दुर्योधनोऽब्रवीत्। व्येतु वो भीरहं कृष्णौ प्रेषयिष्यामि मृत्यवे॥
en: But Duryodhana, hearing that confusion created by his own men, said-"Let all your apprehensions be dispelled; I will send the two Krishnas to the abode of Death"

sa: निकृत्या राज्यहरणं वनवासं च पाण्डव। परिक्लेशं च कृष्णाया हदि कृत्वा पराक्रमम्॥
en: O son of Pandu, put forth all your prowess, recollecting the despoliation of your kingdom through deceit, your exile in the woods and the woes of Krishna.

sa: तमनार्यं सदा क्रुद्धं पुरुषं कामचारिणम्। आर्यां युद्धे मतिं कृत्वा जहि पार्थाविचारयन्॥
en: Nobly resolving to fight, O you son of Pritha, slay without any hesitation, this perverse wretch who is ever vindictive and cruel and who is avarice incarnate.

sa: स दिष्ट्या समनुप्राप्तस्तव पार्थ रथान्तिकम्। जह्येनं त्वं महाबाहो यथा वृत्रं पुरंदरः॥
en: By good luck, has he now come near your chariot; O Partha, slay him, O mighty-armed hero, even as Purandara (Indra) slew Vritra (in days gone by).

sa: संजय उवाच इति सात्यकये प्राह तदा देवकिनन्दनः। धनंजयहिते युक्तस्तत्प्रिये सततं रतः॥
en: Sanjaya said Then the son of Devaki did thus speak to Satyaki, he who devoted to Dhananjaya's good and to what was agreeable to him. was ever

sa: को हि शक्तो रणे पार्थ भारतानां महारथौ। भीष्मद्रोणौ युधा जेतुं शक्रतुल्यपराक्रमौ॥
en: Or, O Partha, who else could have conquered in battle those most eminent warriors of the Bharata race-Drona and Bhishma, endued with the prowess of a Sakra.

sa: मध्ये महारथानां च यत्राहन्यत सैन्धवः। हतो भूरिश्रवाश्चैव किं शेषं तत्र मन्यसे॥
en: Since the ruler of Sindhu and Bhurisrava have been slain from the very midst of the mighty-car-warriors, you can (very well) anticipate what the result will be.

sa: ध्रुवं स तेन हन्तव्य इत्यमन्यत पार्थिवः। जीवितं चिरकालं हि भ्रातृणां चाप्यमन्यत॥
en: The Kuru king had considered the slaughter of Bhima to be certain and had considered the length of the days of his brother also to be measured.

sa: अद्य कर्णं हतं दृष्ट्वा धार्तराष्ट्रोऽत्यमर्षणः॥ जानातु मां रणे कृष्ण प्रवरं सर्वधन्विनाम्।
en: Seeing Karna meeting his death today through my arrows, O Krishna, let the savage son of Dhritarashtra acknowledge me to be the peerless archer in the field.

sa: स त्वं कुरु महाबाहो कर्म युक्तमिहात्मनः। मातुलानां पितॄणां च तेजसोऽस्रबलस्य च॥
en: Therefore, O mighty-armed one, do you now perform what will be worthy of yourself, your maternal uncles, your sires and the measure of your energy and might.

sa: तां दृष्ट्वा देवकी शूरो रथस्थां पुरुषर्षभ। नामृष्यत महातेजाः सोमदत्तः शिने प॥
en: O foremost of men, O king, then beholding the princess Devaki on the car of Sini of Sura's line, the highly puissant Somadatta could not broke it.

sa: रथयुक्तो हि दाशार्हो मिषतां सर्वधन्विनाम्। ज्यद्रथाय यात्येष कद कृत्य नो रणे॥
en: Yoking the steeds to the car, he of the Dasharha is proceeding toward race Jayadratha, crushing us in battle before the very eyes of all our bow-men."

sa: तान् निवृत्तान् रणे शूरान् राधेयः शत्रुतापनः :॥ अनेकशो महाराज बभञ्ज पुरुषर्षभः।
en: O king, those brave warriors were repeatedly broken down in that light by the son of Radha, the smiter of his enemies and powerful like a bull.

sa: पताकाश्च सतूणीरा रश्मीन् योक्त्राणि च प्रभो। चिच्छेद तिलश: क्रुद्धः शरैः संनतपर्वभिः॥
en: (And), inflamed with rage (he) cut-off into very small fragments, with straight arrows, the flags, the quivers, the strings and the terraces, O lord, (of Prativindhya,s) car.

sa: त्वं हि कृष्णौ रणे शक्तः संसाधयितुमाहवे। तवैव भारो राधेय प्रत्युद्याहि धनंजयम्॥
en: You are the only man who can cope with the Krishnas in battle, so make your march, O son of Radha; you alone are capable of it.

sa: यथा पाण्डवमुख्योऽसौ न हनिष्यति सैन्धवम्। न हि मे युध्यमानस्य सायकानस्यतः शितान्॥
en: I shall do that by which this foremost of the Pandavas will not succeed in slaying the Sindhu-king. So long as I shall fight discharging sharp arrows.

sa: तस्य मद्राधिपो हत्वा चतुरो स्थवाजिनः। सूतं ध्वजं च समरे शराभ्यां संन्यपातयत्॥
en: The king of Madra, (also) destroying the four horses of his car, cut down with two shafts, in that engagement, the umbrella and the standard (of Virata).

sa: तमब्रुवन् देवगणां यं भवान् संनियोक्ष्यते। स भविष्यति देवेशं सारथिस्ते न संशयः॥
en: The celestials replied him, saying-"O Lord of the gods, he will be your charioteer, whomever you will be pleased to appoint. There is no doubt about it."

sa: धृतराष्ट्र उवाच तेषां संलोड्यमानानां पाण्डवैर्विहतौजसाम्। अन्धे तमसि मग्नानामासीत् किं वो मनस्तदा।॥
en: Dhritarashtra said When drowned in that blinding darkness you were agitated by the Pandavas and were deprived of your energy, what became the state of your minds?

sa: कर्णस्य निधनं श्रुत्वा विजयं फाल्गुनस्य च। अश्रद्धेयमहं मन्ये वधं कर्णस्य संजय॥
en: Having heard of the intelligence of the slaughter of Karna and the victory of Falguna. To me, O Sanjaya, the death of Karna, seems to be incredible.

sa: ततस्तद् युद्धमभवत् कुरूमां सुमहद् बलैः। न ह्यत्रासीदनिर्भित्रो रथः सादी हयो गजः॥
en: The great fighting still went on between the Kurus and (Arjuna) and all the elephants, horses, cavalry and car-warriors were wounded i.e. (no body came out scatheless).

sa: राजयाजकयाज्यानां मद्रकाणां च यन्मलम्। तद् भवेद् वै तव मलं यद्यस्मान विमुञ्चसि॥
en: The sin of those persons who appoint Kshatriyas as their priests as well as that of the Madrakas will visit you if you do not abandon me.

sa: प्रभावं नात्र पश्यामि पाण्डवानां कथंचन॥ यस्तान् बलवतो नित्यं मन्यसे त्वं द्विजाधम
en: I do not see in it any prowess on the part of the Pandavas. Those whom you, you that are the basest of men, always deem powerful.

sa: विव्याध चैनं दशभिः सम्यगस्तैः शरोत्तमैः॥ वर्म चाशु समासाद्य ते भित्त्वा क्षितिमाविशन्।
en: He then pierced the latter with ten excellent shafts all well-directed. But striking against Duryodhana's armour they were shattered into pierces and fell down on the earth.

sa: त्वयि चाहं महाबाहो प्रद्युम्ने वा महारथे। नृपं निक्षिप्य गच्छेयं निरपेक्षो जयद्रथम्॥
en: O nighty-arined hero, making over the inonarch to you or to the mighty car-warriors Pradyumna only, can I I go to slaughter Jayadratha, with an easy heart.

sa: बभूव च समुद्विग्ना दृष्ट्वा तद्दोषमात्मनः। इदं मे किंत्विति ज्ञात्वा पितुर्गत्वाश्रमे स्थिता॥
en: Seeing that evil befall her, she was wrought up with anxiety; and, understanding matters, she said, "What is this?' And, going to her father's hermitage, stayed there.

sa: सा क्षिप्ता राक्षसेन्द्रस्य तस्मिञ्छूले पपात ह। भिन्नः शक्त्या महाशूलो निपपात गतद्युतिः॥
en: And when hurled, it alighted on that same dart of the Raksasa chief. And thereat, with its splendour lost, the mighty dart, riven, dropped (to the earth.)

sa: आयताञ्चितलाकॅलः ततः किलकिलाशब्दं शुश्रावासन्नमम्बरे॥ हनूमत्कर्मदृप्तानां नदतां काननौकसाम्। किष्किन्धामुपयातानां सिद्धिं कथयतामिव ॥
en: Thereupon he heard in the sky the joyous sounds of the monkeys proud on account of Hanuman's work, proceeding towards Kişkindhā and as if announcing their success.

sa: किं तु तत् कारणं येन रामो दृढपराक्रमः। रक्षसापहृतां भार्यामिष्टां यो नाभिपद्यते॥
en: (I am at a loss to ascertain) why Rāma of firm prowess, dose not regain me, his beloved spouse who have been borne away by the Räkşasa.

sa: ततः कुद्धेन तेनासि शप्तः परमतेजसा। गतोऽसि येन देवेन्द्र दशाभागविपर्ययम्॥ यस्मान्मे धर्षिता पत्नी त्वया वासव निर्भयात्। तस्मात्त्वं समरे शक्र शत्रुहस्तं गमिष्यसि॥
en: You were then imprecated by him, enraged and gifted with great effulgence saying, 'O lord of the celestials, you have attained to a change of circumstances-for which, O Vásava, you have fearlessly ravished my spouse. You shall, therefore, O Sakra, go under the arms of the enemies, in conflict.

sa: तारया चाभ्यनुज्ञाताः सर्वा वानरयोषितः। नेपथ्यविधिपूर्वं तु कृत्वा चापि प्रदक्षिणम्॥ अध्यारोहन्विमानं तत्सीतादर्शनकाझ्या।
en: Being thus commanded by Tārā, the wives of the monkeys, putting on all their ornaments and circumamubulating (her) ascended the car, with a view to behold Sitā.

sa: अर्थसिद्धौ हरिश्रेष्ठ गच्छ सौम्य यथासुखम्। समानय च वैदेहीं राघवेण महात्मना ॥
en: Your end having been attained, go, O mild one, O foremost of monkeys, according to your pleasure. Bring about the meeting of Vaidehī with the high-souled Rāghava.

sa: दशग्रीव महाबाहो नार्हसे वक्तुमीदृशम्॥ सौभ्रात्रं नास्ति शूराणां शृणु चेदं वचो मम।
en: O Ten-necked one, O long-armed (hero), it does not behove you to speak thus. Faternal feeling there is none among heroes. Listen to these words of mine!

sa: यदि वा मन्यसे वीर वसैकाहमरिंदम। कस्मिश्चित् संवृते देशे विश्रान्तः श्वो गमिष्यसि॥
en: O hero, O slayer of foes, if it please you, you may relieve yourself of the toil by living in a secret nook and then proceed to-morrow.

sa: तारया चाभ्यनुज्ञाताः सर्वा वानरयोषितः। नेपथ्यविधिपूर्वं तु कृत्वा चापि प्रदक्षिणम्॥ अध्यारोहन्विमानं तत्सीतादर्शनकाझ्या।
en: Being thus commanded by Tārā, the wives of the monkeys, putting on all their ornaments and circumamubulating (her) ascended the car, with a view to behold Sitā.

sa: नानुकीर्त्या गुणास्तस्य धर्मतः शीलतस्तथा। प्रजापतेः पुत्र इति वक्तुं शक्यं हि नामतः॥
en: His virtues, springing from righteousness and excellency of character, are past all delineation; I can only say that, forsooth, he went by the name of Prajāpati's son.

sa: शिरो मायामयं गृह्य राघवस्य निशाचर। मां त्वं समुपतिष्ठस्व महच्च सशरं धनुः॥
en: O ranger of the night, do you, taking an illusory head of Rāghava, as well as a mighty bow with the shaft (set), present yourself before me.

sa: पितामहमुखाश्चैव सर्वे देवाः प्रहर्षिताः॥ ज्ञात्वा लोकगतिं सर्वां तस्य मृत्युं च रक्षसः।
en: Being apprised of the plight of people (brought about by him) and of the death of that Rākşasa the patriarch Brahmă and other gods were greatly delighted.

sa: अथ तां जातसंतापां तेन वाक्येन मोदिताम्। सरमा हादयामास महीं दग्धामिवाम्भसा ॥
en: Burning with grief on account of those words,* Sarama gladdened and cheered her, even as masses of clouds (cheer up) the burning Earth. *i.e.the words of Ravana.

sa: एतस्मिन्नन्तरे मैन्दो द्विविदाभ्याशमागमत्। तौ शोणिताक्षयूपाक्षौ प्लवंगाभ्यां तरस्विनौ। चक्रतुः समरे तीव्रमाकर्षोत्पाटनं भृशम्॥
en: In the meanwhile Mainda came to the side of Dvivida. And śoṇitākṣa and Yüpākşa, bestirring themselves, began to vehemently and forcibly drag and pull those (two) monkeys.

sa: सह सर्वैर्हरिश्रेष्ठैः सुवर्णपवनोपमैः। वानराणां तु षट्त्रिंशत्कोट्यः प्रख्यातयूथपाः॥ निपीड्योपनिविष्टाश्च सुग्रीवो यत्र वानरः।
en: And accompanied by all the foremost monkeys resembling Suparņa or the Wind, twenty kotis of renowned monkey-leaders, blocking up all sides, stationed themselves near the monkeys, Sugriva.

sa: भित्त्वा रथं शरै रामो हत्वा अश्वानपातयत्। विरथो वसुधास्थः स मकाराक्षो निशाचरः॥
en: And with arrows Rāma sundered the chariot and killing the horses brought them down. And the night-ranger Makarākṣa was brought down on the earth from the chariot.

sa: हा राक्षसचमूमुख्य मम वत्स महाबल॥ जित्वेन्द्रं कथमद्य त्वं लक्ष्मणस्य वशं गतः।
en: O foremost in the Räkşasa army! O my child endowed with high might! Having conquered Indra himself, wherefore today have you come under the sway of Lakşmaņa?

sa: बद्धस्य बहुभिः पाशैर्यन्त्रितस्य च राक्षसैः। न मे पीडाभवत् काचिद् दिक्षोर्नगरी दिवा॥
en: Although bound and fettered with many ropes I did not feel the least anguish for I was very much anxious to behold the city during the day.

sa: स चिच्छेद शितैर्बाणैः सप्तभिः कायभेदनैः। अङ्गदो विव्यथेऽभीक्ष्णं स पपात मुमोह च॥
en: Thereat he* severed it with seven sharp shafts capable of piercing the body. And Angada experienced a sharp pang and fell down deprived of his senses. *Kumbha.

sa: दशाननः क्रोधविवृत्तनेत्रो यतो यतोऽभ्येति रथेन संख्ये। ततस्ततस्तस्य शरप्रवेगं सोढुं न शेकुर्हरियूथपास्ते॥
en: Wherever in the encounter, the Ten-headed Räksasa, whirling his eyes in ire, went in his car the monkey leaders could not stand the vehemence of his arrows.

sa: स गतासुर्गतश्रीको गतसत्त्वो गतेन्द्रियः। पपात सहसा भूमौ छिन्नमूल इव दुमः। ५४॥
en: Then bereft of life and shorn of nerve and devoid of sense he suddenly dropped down to the earth like a tree whose roots have been severed.

sa: स त्वां मनुजशार्दूलः क्षिप्रं प्राप्स्यति राघवः। समित्रबान्धवं हत्वा रावणं जनकात्मजे॥ ।
en: O daughter of the king Janaka bringing about the destruction of Rāvaņa, with all his kith and kin, Rāghava, the foremost of men, shall soon regain you.

sa: तं दृष्ट्वा वदनान्मुक्तं चन्द्रं राहुमुखादिव। अब्रवीत् सुरसा देवी स्वेन रूपेण वानरम्॥
en: Seeing him out of her mouth like the Moon out of the mouth of Rāhu, the venerable Surasā spoke to the monkey in her native form, saying.

sa: नहि मे जीवितेनार्थो नैवार्थेन च भूषणैः। वसन्त्या राक्षसीमध्ये विना रामं महारथम्॥
en: Of what avail are wealth, ornament and life to me, who am living in the midst of the Răkşasas and separated from Ráma, of the mighty car?

sa: ददर्श कान्ताश्च समालभन्त्यस्तथापरास्तत्र पुनः स्वपन्त्यः। सुरूपवक्त्राश्च तथा हसन्त्यः क्रुद्धाः पराश्चापि विनिःश्वसन्त्यः॥
en: And (he) saw debonair damsels daubing their frames with pastes; and others, again, sleeping, and fair-faced wenches smiling, and others sighing hard under the influence of anger.

sa: शो नेत्रे करौ पादौ गुल्फावूरू समौ चितौ। अनुवृत्तनखाः स्निग्धाः समाश्चाङ्गुलयो मम॥
en: My temples, and eyes hands, feet, ankles, and thighs are equal. And my fingers are furnished with round nails, and are plump and even in the middle.

sa: नहि त्वं शोचितव्यो मे प्रख्यातबलपौरुषः। स्त्रीस्वभावात्तु मे बुद्धिः कारुण्ये परिवर्तते ॥
en: You well-known for your strength and manliness, are not worthy of being grieved by me. On account of my effeminate nature my understanding is possessed by sorrow.

sa: सदृशं यच्च कालेऽस्मिन्कर्तुं स्नेहेन बन्धुना। शत्रूणां कदनं पश्य क्रियमाणं मया रणे॥
en: What a friend from affection should do at a time like this, I shall do the same. See the havoc I spread among the foes in fight.

sa: अश्वं मुक्तं गजो दृष्ट्वा क्वचिद्रीतोऽपसर्पति। भीतो भीतं गजं दृष्ट्वा क्वचिदश्वो निवर्तते॥
en: Sometimes, an elephant seeing a steed let loose, was flying away in fear, and sometimes a horse seeing a frightened elephant, was stopping, himself seized with fear.

sa: मां वा गृहीयुरावृत्य बहवः शीघ्रकारिणः। स्यादियं चागृहीतार्था मम च ग्रहणं भवेत्॥
en: And if that host of skilled demons, succeed in making me a captive, too shall be in their hands and Sītā shall remain ignorant of my object.

sa: भीरोः प्रवादाः श्रूयन्ते यस्तु जीवति धिक्कृतः। मार्गः सत्पुरुषैर्जुष्टः सेव्यतां त्यज्यतां भयम्॥
en: He that live, despised (of all), hear the reproach of being a craven. Therefore do you follow the way frequented by the worthy, and cast off fear.

sa: तेन सीता जनस्थानाद्धृता हत्वा जटायुषम्। रुद्धा च विवशा दीना राक्षसीभिः सुरक्षिता॥
en: By him, slaying the vulture Jatayu, was carried away Sītā from Janasthana. She is imprisoned, brought under his sway, poorly, and being well guarded by the Rakşasees.

sa: कुम्भकर्ण कुले जातो धृष्टः प्राकृतदर्शनः। अविलसो न शक्नोषि कृत्यं सर्वत्र वेदितुम्॥
en: O Kumbhakarņa, although sprung in a noble line, you are wondrous haughty and of a vulgar form; and you are not everywhere competent to discern your course.

sa: यस्तु दोषस्त्वया प्रोक्तो ह्यादानेऽरिबलस्य च। तत्र ते कीर्तयिष्यामि यथाशास्त्रमिदं शृणु ॥
en: And hear, I shall relate, what the Sastras say regarding the weak points you have mentioned as to the advisability of taking the enemies to our side.

sa: तं तु गत्वा परं पारं समुद्रस्य नदीपतेः। ददर्शाश्रममेकान्ते पुण्ये रम्ये वनान्तरे॥
en: Then repairing to the other shore of that lord of rivers, the ocean, Rāvana saw an asylum lying in the forest in a charming and sacred recess.

sa: देवासुरे च संग्रामे जनन्यै तव पार्थिवः। सम्प्रहृष्टो ददौ राजा वरमाराधितः प्रभुः॥
en: Then on the occasion of the war between the gods and the Asuras, that master, the king, well pleased (with her), being besought, granted her a boon.

sa: अब्रवील्लक्ष्मणो रामं साक्षाद् धर्ममिव स्थितम्। रोचते मे तथा प्राज्ञ क्षिप्रमारुह्यतामिति ॥
en: Then Lakşmana spoke to Rāma like to manifest Virtue on earth, "O wise one, even this is relished also by me. Do you speedily ascend (the car.)"

sa: देवतार्थे च पित्रर्थे ब्राह्मणाभ्यागतेषु च। योधेषु मित्रवर्गेषु कच्चिद् गच्छति ते व्ययः॥
en: And did you spend your wealth in the interests of the deities, or the pitris, or the Brāhmaṇas who have come to you, or warriors, or friends?

sa: दुरासदा हि ते वीराः सत्त्ववन्तो महाबलाः। फलामूलानि ते तत्र रक्षन्ते भीमविक्रमाः॥
en: Those heroes are hard to approach; and they are truthful and possessed of great might. And there they of dreadful prowess stow away their fruits and roots.

sa: हितमुक्तं त्वया देवि स्निग्धया सदृशं वचः। कुलं व्यपदिशन्त्या च धर्मज्ञे जनकात्मजे॥
en: O noble lady, you have spoken wild words fraught with worth and profit; and, O Janaka's daughter versed in virtue, you have expounded the duties of Kșatriyas.

sa: मयो नाम महातेजा मायावी वानरर्षभ॥ तेनेदं निर्मितं सर्वं मायया काञ्चनं वनम्।
en: O foremost of monkeys, there is one, named Maya, spreader of illusions. By him has this entire golden grove been constructed through his wonderful power of construction.

sa: तस्मिन् महति संग्रामे पुरुषान् क्षतविक्षतान्। रात्रौ प्रसुप्तान ध्वन्ति स्म तरसापास्य राक्षसाः॥
en: And in that mighty conflict the Rākşasas during the night used to drag by main force persons asleep having their bodies cut all over, and kill them.

sa: प्रमत्तानप्रमत्तान् वा नरा मांसाशिनो भृशम्। विध्यन्ति विमुखांश्चापि न च दोषोऽत्र विद्यते॥
en: And even many royal ascetics, versed in religious lore, go a-hunting; and hence you had been killed by me with a shaft, O monkey, in the conflict.

sa: एष राम मुनिश्रेष्ठ एष विग्रहवांस्तपः। एष धर्मः परो नित्यं वीर्यस्यैष परायणम्॥
en: This, O Rāma, is the foremost of ascetics, this one is Asceticism incarnate. This one ever abide by duty; and he is the stay of ascetic energy.

sa: अभिमानं च मानं च त्यक्त्वा वर्तस्व मातृषु। अनुराजानमार्यां च कैकेयीमम्ब कारय॥
en: Banishing pride and self-love, do you bear yourself towards my mothers. And, O mother, do you show respect to Kaikeyi, who is followed by the king himself.

sa: अथवा किं मयैतेन राज्यद्रव्यमयेन तु। उद्धृतं मे स्वयं तोयं व्रतादेशं करिष्यति॥
en: Or what necessity have I with all these articles of installation; water drawn from the well by myself shall do for entering into the vow of exile.

sa: प्रत्युवाच ततो रामं प्राञ्जलिर्वानरेश्वरः। यत् त्वमात्थ नरश्रेष्ठ तत् तथैव न संशयः॥
en: Thereupon that lord of monkeys spoke to Răma, with folded hands, saying:-There is not the least doubt, О best of men, in all that you had said.

sa: भवान् क्रियापरो लोके भवान् देवपरायणः। आस्तिको धर्मशीलश्च व्यवसायी च राघव ॥
en: O Rāghava, you are devoted to pious actions and the services of the Deity in this world-and pious, energetic and did believe in the existence of God.

sa: अरण्यं च सह भ्रात्रा लक्ष्मणेन गमिष्यति। तस्मिन्नर्थे नियुक्तः सन् पित्रा सत्यपराक्रमः॥
en: He (Rāma) shall repair to the forest in company with his brother, Laksmana; that one having truth for prowess, having commissioned to that effect by his sire.

sa: दीर्घकालात् समुत्थाय संज्ञां लब्ध्वा स वीर्यवान्। नेत्राभ्यामश्रुपूर्णाभ्यां दीनामुद्वीक्ष्य मातरम्॥ सोऽमात्यमध्ये भरतो जननीमभ्यकुत्सयत्। राज्यं न कामये जातु मन्त्रये नापि मातरम्॥ अभिषेकं न जानामि योऽभूद् राज्ञा समीक्षितः। विप्रकृष्टे ह्यहं देशे शत्रुघ्नसहितोऽभवम्॥
en: Arising after a long while he had regained his consciousness, Bharata endowed with prowess, regarding his distressed mother with eyes filled with tears, began to tax her in the midst of the courtiers: “I had never desired the kingdom. I had never consulted my mother. Nor did I know the installation that had been thought of by the monarch. I was then living in a far country in company with Satrughna."

sa: न रोचते ममाप्येतदार्ये यद् राघवो वनम्। त्यक्त्वा राज्यश्रियं गच्छेत् स्त्रिया वाक्यवशंगतः॥ विपरीतश्च वृद्धश्च विषयैश्च प्रधर्षितः। नृपः किमिव न ब्रूयाच्चोद्यमानः समन्मथः॥
en: I like it not, Oh worshipful one, that Räghava, should repair to the forest, renouncing this grandeur of sovereignty. The king is uxorious, old and therefore of perverted judgement and is addicted to worldly affairs; being under the influence of his wife and passion what could he not speak?

sa: सिद्धाश्रम इति ख्यातः सिद्धो ह्यत्र महातपाः। एतस्मिन्नेव काले तु राजा वैरोचनिबंलिः॥ निर्जित्य दैवतगणान् सेन्द्रान् सहमरुद्गणान्। कारयामास तद्राज्यं त्रिषु लोकेषु विश्रुतः॥
en: And this famed as Siddhāśrama, in consequence of that one of potent asceticism having attained fruition there. And it came to pass that at this time Virocana's son, king Välī; having vanquished the celestials with Indra and the Maruts, established that dominion of his, famous in the three worlds.

sa: तस्य पाण्डुरमाजकुश्छत्रं हेमपरिष्कृतम्॥ शुक्ले च वालव्यजने हेमदण्डे यशस्करे। तथा रत्नानि सर्वाणि सर्वबीजौषधानि च॥ सक्षीराणां च वृक्षाणां प्ररोहान् कुसुमानि च। शुक्लानि चैव वस्त्राणि श्वेतं चैवानुलेपनम्॥ सुगन्धीनि च माल्यानि स्थलजान्यम्बुजानि च। चन्दनानि च दिव्यानि गन्धांश्च विविधान् बहून्॥ अक्षतं जातरूपं च प्रियङ्गुमधुसर्पिषी। दधि चर्म च वैयाघ्रं पराध्यौ चाप्युपानहौ॥ समालम्भनमादाय गोरोचनं मनःशिलाम्। आजग्मुस्तत्र मुदिता वराः कन्याश्च षोडश॥
en: The monkeys brought for him a coppercoloured golden umbrella, white chowries, a magnificent golden staff, diverse jewels, various seeds and medicating drugs, roots and flowers of glomerous fig trees, white clothes, white sandal paste, fragrant garlands, flowers growing in water and on land, celestial sandal and various scents, fried grain, gold, Pryangu' honey, clarified butter, curd tiger-skin, a pair of excellent sandals, gorocana? and red Arsenic. Carrying all those things there came sixteen maids, highly delighted. 1. A medicinal plant, and perfume, commonly known by the name Pryangu and described in some places as a fragrant seed. 2. A bright yellow pigment prepared from the urine of a cow, or committed in the shape of scibule by the animal, or according to some found in the head of a

sa: एषा च सुकुमारी च खेदैश्च न विमानिता। प्राज्यदोषं वनं प्राप्ता भर्तृस्नेहप्रचोदिता॥
en: Of tender years and unkn wn to hardship, she has come to the forest rife with troubles, being urged by the love she bears to her lord.

sa: निरीक्षमाणापि च भूमिमग्रतः। बभूव हृष्टा नचिरेण चानती प्रियस्य रामस्य समागमं तदा॥
en: Desired by Bharata to halt, that army, looking in the direction of the smoke, rejoiced soon on learning that the beloved Rāma had arrived (at that place).

sa: जटायो यदि शक्नोषि वाक्यं व्याहरितुं पुनः। सीतामाख्याहि भद्रं ते वधमाख्याहि चात्मनः॥
en: May good betide you, O Jatayu; if you are capable of speaking again, do you relate how Sītā has been carried away and you have been killed.

sa: तं तु वज्रमिवोत्सृष्टमाहवे दानवारिणा। वाग्वजं भरतेनोक्तममनोज्ञं परंतपः॥ प्रगृह्य रामो बाहु वै पुष्पिताङ्ग इव दुमः। वने परशुना कृत्तस्तथा भुवि पपात ह॥
en: On that thunder-bolt of a speech being uttered by Bharata, like to a (real) thunder-bolt hurled in battle by the enemy of the Dānavas (Indra), that subduer of foes, Rāma, stretching his arms, fell down to the earth, like a blossoming tree that has been hewn by an axe.

sa: विश्रुतस्रिषु लोकेषु यशसा विक्रमेण च। पितृव्रतत्वं सत्यं च त्वयि धर्मश्च पुष्कलः॥
en: Famous over the three worlds in high worth and prowess, in you are found truth and virtue in profusion and obedience to the mandate of your sire.

sa: ततो वैवस्वतं दृष्ट्वा तं प्रवक्ष्यामि भारतीम्। क्षमतां धर्मराजो मे बिभृयात् पितरावयम्॥
en: Seeing Vivasvata's son, I will say to him, Do you, O lord of justice forgive me, and let this my son, continue to maintain us, his parents.

sa: यदि मे भगवान् प्रीतो यद्यस्ति तपसः फलम्। सगरस्यात्मजाः सर्वे मत्तः सलिलमाप्नुयुः॥ गङ्गायाः सलिलक्लिन्ने भस्मन्येषां महात्मनाम्। स्वर्गं गच्छेयुरत्यन्तं सर्वे च प्रपितामहाः॥
