en: If, adorable one, you are pleased with me, if you would grant me the fruit of my asceticism, may Sagara's sons receive water at my hands; and on the ashes of those high-souled ones being laved by the waters of Gangā, may my greatgrand-father without fail repair to heaven!

sa: कोशे जनपदे बान्धवेषु सुहृत्सु च ॥ कुशलं कौशिको राज्ञः पर्यपृच्छत् सुधार्मिकः।
en: And the exceedingly virtuous descendant of Kusika asked the king concerning the welfare of the exchequer, and the provinces; and the peace of his friends and acquaintances.

sa: सभार्यं सम्प्रसुप्तं तु श्रान्तं सम्प्रेक्ष्य लक्ष्मणः। कथयामास सूताय रामस्य विविधान् गुणान्॥
en: When Lakşmaņa found that Rāma afflicted with fatigue had slept together with his spouse, he began to speak to the charioteer concerning the various qualities of Rāma.

sa: अम्ब सम्भृत्य सम्भारान् दुःखं हृदि निगृह्य च। वनवासकृता बुद्धिर्मम धानुवर्त्यताम् ॥
en: Desisting from the ceremonies of installation and allaying your sorrow in your heart do you, Oh my mother, follow my pious decision about retiring to the forest.

sa: सप्तधा तु भवेन्मूर्धा मुनौ तपसि तिष्ठति। ज्ञानाद् विसृजतः शस्त्रं तादृशे ब्रह्मवादिनि॥
en: Your head would have been severed in seven, if you had discharged the weapon knowingly at such an ascetic staying in austerities and versed in the Vedas.

sa: अन्तभौमानि सत्त्वानि वीर्यवन्ति महान्ति च। तेषां तु प्रतिघातार्थं सासिं गृह्णीष्व कार्मुकम्॥
en: And as there are strong and mighty creatures inhabiting the Earth's interior, with the view of resisting them, do you take your how along with your scimitar.

sa: श्रुतिस्तु खल्वियं सत्या लौकिकी प्रतिभाति मे। यदन्नः पुरुषो भवति तदन्नास्तस्य देवता॥
en: Now the tradition in vogue among men, appearth to be true, viz., that “the fare that is pareaken by a person, is also partaken by his deity."

sa: दर्शने मा कृथाः बुद्धिं राघवस्य वरानने। कास्य शक्तिरिहागन्तुमपि सीते मनोरथैः ॥
en: And, O you of a handsome countenance, do not wish for the sight of Rāghava. O Sītā, what power has he to come hither even in thought?

sa: अस्मत्त्यक्तं प्रपद्यन्तु सेव्यमानं त्यजन्तु च। तृणमांसफलादानं देशं व्यालमृगद्विजम्॥ प्रपद्यतां हि कैकेयी सपुत्रा सह बान्धवैः। राघवेण वयं सर्वे वने वत्स्याम निर्वृताः॥
en: Let them occupy the tracts left behind by us, and let them renounce such abounding in serpents, beasts, and birds, as yield grass, meat, and fruits. Let Kaikeyi (reign in this realm) along with her sons sons and adherents; we, renouncing homes, will dwell in the forest with Raghava.

sa: अद्यैव दीक्षां प्रविश भद्रं ते मुनिपुंगव। सिद्धाश्रमोऽयं सिद्धः स्यात् सत्यमस्तु वचस्तव॥
en: Be you even to-day initiated to the ceremony. Good betide you, O best of ascetics! Let this Siddhāśrama verily attain fruition, and let your words be verified!

sa: इति ब्रुवन्तं मुदिताः प्रत्यनन्दन् नृपा नृपम्। वृष्टिमन्तं महामेघं नर्दन्त इव बर्हिणः॥
en: As the king had said this, the princes, exceedingly delighted, seconded him even as peacocks dance at sight of a mighty mass of clouds showering down rain.

sa: किं त्वामन्यत वैदेहः पिता मे मिथिलाधिपः। राम जामातरं प्राप्य स्त्रियं पुरुषविग्रहम्॥
en: What thought of you, O Rāma, my father, the king of Mithilā, accepting you as his son-in-law, who was a man if form but (in deeds)a woman?

sa: एवं ते भाषमाणस्य पद्मा श्रीरुपतिष्ठताम्। यस्त्वं ज्येष्ठे नृपसुते पृथिवीं दातुमिच्छसि ॥
en: For saying this, may Lakşmi seated on the lotus remain at they side; inasmuch you wish to confer the earth on the eldest son of the monarch!

sa: कदायोध्यां महाबाहुः पुरी वीरः प्रवेक्ष्यति। पुरस्कृत्य रथे सीतां वृषभो गोवधूमिव ॥
en: When will the mighty-armed hero enter the city of Ayodhyā, placing Sītā before him on the car, like to a bull having his bovine mate before him?

sa: तं सा समासाद्य विशुद्धसत्त्वं शोकेन सम्भ्रान्तशरीरभावा। मनस्विनी वाक्यमुवाच तारा रामं रणोत्कर्षणलब्धलक्ष्यम्॥
en: And having reached the pure-souled Rāma, who had his ends fully attained in battle, the high-minded Tārā, having her frame worked with grief, spoke to him, saying.

sa: अनासादयमानं तं सीतां शोकपरायणम्॥ पङ्कमासाद्य विपुलं सीदन्तमिव कुञ्जरम्। लक्ष्मणो राममत्यर्थमुवाच हितकाम्यया॥
en: Being sunk in grief on Sītā's account he became worn out like to an elephant fallen in mud.' Thereat for his well being, Laksmana spoke to him.

sa: तस्य मूर्जा प्रणामं त्वं सपुत्रः सहबान्धवः। गच्छ शीघ्रं महाराज रोषो ह्यद्योपशाम्यताम्॥
en: O king, along with your children and friends do you repair to him speedily and bowing to him with your head down do you pacify his wrath.

sa: देव यस्या भयाद् रामं नानुपृच्छसि सारथिम्। नेह तिष्ठति कैकेयी विश्रब्धं प्रतिभाष्यताम्॥
en: O worshipful one, she from fear of whom you do not speak to the charioteer, Kaikeyi, is not here. Do you therefore speak to him without fear.

sa: शत्रुघ्नं चापि धर्मात्मा अब्रवीन्मिथिलेश्वरः॥ श्रुतकीर्तेर्महाबाहो पाणिं गृह्णीष्व पाणिना। सर्वे भवन्तः सौम्याश्च सर्वे सुचरितव्रताः॥ पत्नीभिः सन्तु काकुत्स्था मा भूत् कालस्य पर्ययः।
en: The righteous lord of Mithila spoke also to Satrughna, saying, Do you, O you of mighty arms, take Śrutakīrti's hand by your own. May you all be good, and vowed to excellent life! And be, you Kākutsthas, you united with your wives. Let there be no delay about it.

sa: पित्रा निरस्तः कुद्धेन सभार्यः क्षीणजीवितः॥ स हन्ता तस्य सैन्यस्य रामः क्षत्रियपांसनः।
en: Having been expelled by his enraged sire, that disgrace of Kșatriyas, the weak Rāma, living in company with his wife has effected the destruction of this army.

sa: गतानां तु ततः पूजामृषिपुत्रश्चकार ह। इदमर्ध्यमिदं पाद्यमिदं मूलं फलं च नः॥
en: When they had come there, the saint's son received them hospitably, saying, 'Here is Arghya,' 'Here is water for washing the feet,' 'Here are fruits and roots.'

sa: तत्र जातं बहु द्रव्यं धनधान्यमजाविकम्। ततो वृणीष्व कैकेयि यद्यत् त्वं मनसेच्छसि॥
en: In these are produced many things, wealth and corn and animals. Do you, O Kaikeyi, ask for those things that your mind may take a fancy to.

sa: तां समीक्ष्य तदा द्वा:स्थो भृशं पापस्य कारिणीम्। गृहीत्वाकरुणं कुब्जां शत्रुघ्नाय न्यवेदयत्॥
en: At that time seeing that one of horrible misdeeds, (Bharata) who stood near the door, seizing the hump backed one ruthlessly, took her to Satrughna, and said.

sa: क्रतुं समाप्य तु तदा न्यायत: पुरुषर्षभः। ऋत्विग्भ्यो हि ददौ राजा धरां तां कुलवर्धनः॥ एवं दत्त्वा प्रहृष्टोऽभूच्छीमानिक्ष्वाकुनन्दनः। ऋत्विजस्त्वब्रुवन् सर्वे राजानं गतकिल्विषम्॥
en: Having completed that sacrifice, that perpetuator of his race, and foremost of men, the king, conferied on the priests the earth; and having conferred it, that auspicious descendant of Ikşvāku experienced high delight. And then the priests spoke to that monarch, who had all his sins purged off saying.

sa: प्रायेण हि नरश्रेष्ठ ज्येष्ठाः पितृषु वल्लभाः। मातृणां च कनीयांसस्तस्माद् रक्ष्ये कनीयसम्॥
en: O foremost of men, the eldest sons are generally the best beloved of their fathers; and the youngest, of their mother, therefore the youngest I would retain.

sa: वयं खलु हता राम यत् त्वया ह्युपवञ्चिताः। कैकेय्या वशमेष्यामः पापाया दुःखभागिनः॥
en: O Rāma, it is we, wretched that we are, that are undone, as we, deprived of your company, shall come under the sinful Kaikeyi expressing great misery.

sa: भूमिः कीर्तिर्यशो लक्ष्मीः परुषं प्रार्थयन्ति हि। सत्यं समनुवर्तन्ते सत्यमेव भजेत् ततः॥
en: The earth and fame and renown and auspiciousness pay court to the truthful person. The good follow truth, therefore even truth is to be sought by all).

sa: वाङ्मात्रेण तदा राजा कैकेय्या स्ववशं कृतः। प्रचस्कन्द विनाशाय पाशं मृग इवात्मनः॥
en: When the king was completely brought under the influence of Kaikeyi, he was ensnared by her speech for his destruction, like a deer entering into the noose.

sa: कुरुष्व पितरं पुत्र सुदृष्टं धर्मवत्सलम्। दुर्लभं दर्शनं तस्य तव वत्स भविष्यति॥
en: Do you cast for good, O my son, your looks towards your pious sire, for since now it will be hard for you to see him again.

sa: ताः प्रहृष्टाः प्रकृतयो बलाध्यक्षा बलस्य च। श्रुत्वा यात्रां समाज्ञप्तां राघवस्य निवर्तने॥
en: Hearing that the army had been ordered to march forth for bringing back Rāma, the subjects as well as the generals of the forces became exceedingly delighted.

sa: तिष्ठ तिष्ठ वरारोहे न तेऽस्ति करुणा मयि। नात्यर्थं हास्यशीलासि किमर्थं मामुपेक्षसे॥
en: Wait, wait, O you fair damsel, you have no compassion for me! Never had you mock me before in this way! Why do you neglect me now?

sa: उपकारं कृतं वीरो नाप्ययं विस्मृतः कपिः। रामेण वीर सुग्रीवो यदन्यैर्दुष्करं रणे॥
en: Nor has the heroic monkey, O hero, forgotten the good, incapable of being done by others in battle, that the hero; Rāma, has done in his behalf.

sa: कैकेय्याः प्रतिपत्तिर्हि कथं स्यान्मम वेदने। यदि तस्या न भावोऽयं कृतान्तविहितो भवेत्॥
en: Had not destiny been instrumental; in bringing about this; determination in Kaikeyi, she would not have been so much persevering in the infliction of misery upon me.

sa: अनाथ इव भूतानां नाथस्त्वं वासवोपमः। मया प्रेष्येण काकुत्स्थ किमर्थं परितप्यसे ॥
en: Why do you, O Kākutstha, being the lord of all creatures and resembling Väsava himself, and also backed by myself, your servant, grieve like one forlorn ?

sa: स्पन्दते मे दृढं बाहुरुद्विग्नमिव मे मनः। प्रायशश्चाप्यनिष्टानि निमित्तान्युपलक्षये॥ तस्मात् सज्जीभवार्य त्वं कुरुष्व वचनं मम। ममैव हि निमित्तानि सद्यः शंसन्ति सम्भ्रमम्॥
en: My left arm is throbbing, my mind is filled with anxiety and I perceive before me many a bad omen. Do you put on your habiliments, O worshipful one, and act by what I say for your well-being. Methinks from these bad omens some calamity shall soon befall us.

sa: एवं ब्रुवत्यां करुणं दुःशलायां धनंजयः॥ संस्मृत्य देवीं गान्धारीं धृतराष्ट्रं च पार्थिवम्।
en: Recollecting queen Gandhari and king Dhritarashtra, Dhananjaya, afflicted with grief, addressed Dushala who had said so to him, and answered her, censuring Kshatriya practices all the time.

sa: भगदैवतमासं तु एकभक्तेन यः क्षिपेत्। स्त्रीषु वल्लभतां याति वश्याश्चास्य भवन्ति ताः।।२२
en: He who passes the whole month of Bhagadaivata, confining himself every day to only one meal, becomes a favourite with women who, indeed, readily acknowledge his sway.

sa: दिवं हंसप्रयुक्तेन विमानेन स गच्छति। शतं वर्षसहस्राणां मोदते स दिवि प्रभो॥
en: Such a man ascends to Heaven on a car drawn by swans. Gifted with power, he enjoys every sort of happiness in Heaven for a hundred years.

sa: युधिष्ठिर उवाच ब्राह्मणेभ्यः प्रयच्छन्ति दानानि विविधानि च। दातृप्रतिग्रहीत्रोर्वै को विशेषः पितामह॥
en: Yuthishthira said People are seen to make various kinds of gifts to the Brahmanas. What, however, is the difference, O grandfather, between the giver and the receiver?

sa: विकारणं तु निर्दिष्टं श्रूयते ब्रह्मवादिभिः। मनो वाचि तथाऽऽस्वादे दोषा ह्येषु प्रतिष्ठिताः॥
en: It is heard that Brahmavadins point out three causes (for the sin of eating meat). That sin may attach to the mind, to words, and to deeds.

sa: भीष्म उवाच एवमेतन्महाबाहो यथा वदसि भारत। न मांसात्परमं किञ्चिद्रसतो विद्यते भुवि॥
en: Bhishma said O mighty armed one, O Bharata, It is the same as you submit. There is nothing on Earth that is superior to meat in taste.

sa: पञ्चम्यां बहवः पुत्रा जायन्ते कुर्वतां नृप। कुर्वाणास्तु नराः षष्ठ्यां भवन्ति द्युतिभागिनः॥
en: They, O king, who perform the Shraddha on the fifth day, get many sons. Those men who perform the Shraddha on the sixth day, acquire great splendour.

sa: येष्वहःसु कृतैः श्राद्धैर्यत् फलं प्राप्यतेऽनघ। तत् सर्वे कीर्तयिष्यामि यथावत् तन्निबोध मे॥
en: I shall describe to you, O sinless one, what fruits are attained on what days by performing the Shraddha. Do you listen to me with rapt attention.

sa: प्रेतलोकं गते म] तत् तत् सर्वे विभावसुः। प्रतिजानाति पुण्यात्मा तच्च तत्रोपयुज्यते॥
en: When a mortal goes into the regions of the dead the Sun witnesses all his deeds. He who is virtuous, acquires the fruits of his virtue there.

sa: काञ्चनं प्रतिगृह्याथ जपमानो गुरुश्रुतिम्। कृष्णायसं च विवृतं धारयन् मुच्यते द्विजः॥ एवं प्रतिगृहीतेऽथ धने वस्त्रे तथा स्त्रियाम्। एवमेव नरश्रेष्ठ सुवर्णस्य प्रतिग्रहे॥
en: If a Brahmana accepts gold from any one, he becomes cleansed of all sins by silently reciting the great Gayatri, and by holding a piece of iron in his hand, before the public. In accepting money or clothes or women or gold, the purification is the same as before.

sa: देवतास्ते प्रयच्छन्ति ये सुवर्णं ददत्यथ। अग्निगर्हि देवताः सर्वाः सुवर्णं च तदात्मकम्॥
en: Indeed, they who make gifts of gold are considered as givers of celestials. Agni is all the deities in one, and gold has Agni for its essence.

sa: किमर्थं च पुनर्देव प्रकृतिस्थस्त्वया कृतः। तथैव दुमसंच्छन्नः कृतोऽयं ते पिता मम॥
en: Why also, O illustrious god, have you restored the mountain to its former condition? Indeed, having burnt it once, why have you again filled it with trees?

sa: आत्मा धर्मः श्रुतं वेदाः पितरश्चर्षिभिः सह। साक्षात् पितामहो ब्रह्मा गुरवोऽथ प्रजापतिः॥ प्रमाणमुपनीता वै स्थिताश्च न विचालिताः। तदिदं सम्यगारब्धं त्वयात्र भरतर्षभ॥
en: By such conduct you have honoured and maintained the authority of yourself, the scriptures, the Vedas, the Pitris and the Rishis, the Grandfather Brahman himself, and those elders, viz., the Prajapatis. Adherence to the scriptures has been upheld. You have today, O chief of the Bharatas, acted very properly.

sa: उमोवाच भगवन् संशयो मेऽमस्ति तन्मे व्याख्यातुमर्हसि। चातुर्वर्ण्यस्य धर्मं वै नैपुण्येन प्रकीर्तय॥
en: Uma said O Holy One, my doubts have not been removed. You should explain in detail what the duties are of the four respective castes of men.

sa: एते देवि महाभागाः प्राणिनो दानशीलिनः। ब्रह्मणा वै पुरा प्रोक्ताः सर्वस्य प्रियदर्शनाः॥
en: The SelfCreate Brahman himself declared it formerly that it is even such persons, O goddess, who become highly blessed and possessed of liberal dispositions and handsome features.

sa: सोऽस्याः पृथिव्याः कृत्स्नायाः स्रष्टा त्रिभुवनेश्वरः। संहर्ता चैव भूतानां स्थावरस्थ चरस्य च॥
en: He is the Creator of this Earth, and He is the Lord of the three worlds. He is also the Destroyer of all creatures mobile and immobile.

sa: ब्रह्मचर्यस्य च गुणं शृणु त्वं वसुधाधिप।॥ आजन्ममरणाद् यस्तु ब्रह्मचारी भवेदिह। न तस्य किंचिदप्राप्यमिति विद्धि नराधिप।॥ बयः कोट्यस्त्वृषीणां तु ब्रह्मलोके वसन्त्युत।
en: Listen now to me, o king as I explain to you the merits of Brahmacharya. That man who practises the vow of Brahmacharya from his birth to the time of his Death, know, O king, has nothing unattainable! Many millions of Rishis are living in the region of Brahma.

sa: य इदं शृणुयान्नित्यं यश्चापि परिकीर्तयेत्। नाशुभं प्राप्नुयात् किंचित् सोऽमुत्रेह च मानवः।।१२२
en: The man who hears these names every day or who recites them every day, never meets with any evil either in this world or in the next.

sa: पितॄणां परमं भोज्यं तिलाः सृष्टाः स्वयम्भुवा। तिलदानेन वै तस्मात् पितृपक्षः प्रमोदते॥
en: Sesame seeds were created by the Self create Brahmana as the best food for the departed manes. Hence, gifts sesame seeds always please the departed manes greatly.

sa: तां च धर्मेण सम्प्राप्य पालयेयमतन्द्रितः। चतुर्थं तु वरं याचे त्वामहं द्विजसत्तम॥
en: Having acquired the Earth righteously, let me govern her with vigilance. There is a fourth boon which, O foremost of twiceborn person, I solicit thee to grant.

sa: पानीयं परमं दानं दानानां मुनरब्रवीत्। तस्मात् कूपांश्च वापीश्च तडागानि च खानयेत्॥
en: Manu has said that a gift of drink is the best of all gifts: therefore should a man cause wells and tanks and lakes to be excavated.

sa: भद्रा सोमस्य दुहिता रूपेण परमा मता। तस्यास्तुल्यं पति सोम उतथ्यं समपश्यत॥
en: The daughter of Soma, named Bhadra, came to be considered as peerless in beauty. Her father Soma regarded Utathya to be the fittest of husbands for her.

sa: अभिवाद्य तु तं देवाः पृष्ट्वा कुशलमेव च। इदमूचूर्महात्मानं वाक्यं काले जनाधिप॥ दानवैर्युधि भग्न: स्म तथैश्वर्याच्च भ्रंशिताः। तदस्मान्नो भयात् तीव्रात् त्राहि त्वं मुनिपुङ्गव॥
en: Saluting him duly, the celestials made the usual polite enquiries. They then, O king, said these words to that highsouled one, We have been defeated by the Danavas in battle, and have, therefore, been deprived of affluence and prosperity. Do you, therefore, O foremost of ascetics, rescue us from this situation of great fear.

sa: सम्भवन्ति ततः शुक्रात् प्राणिनः पृथिवीपते। अग्नीषोमौ हि तच्छुक्रं सृजतः पुष्यतश्च ह॥
en: From the vital seed thus made, O king, spring various kinds of living creatures. Agni and Soma, living within the body, create and maintain the vital seed.

sa: क्रियतां मद्वचो देवा यथा वै समुदाहृतम्। एतद् वः कुर्वतां श्रेयो भवेन्नैतदकुर्वताम्॥
en: Let the gods do what I have said. By acting according to those words, the gods will reap great advantage. By acting otherwise evil will overtake them.

sa: नारद उवाच अन्नमेव प्रशंसन्ति देवा ऋषिगणास्तथा। लोकतन्त्रं हि संज्ञाश्च सर्वमन्ने प्रतिष्ठितम्॥
en: Narada said The celestials and all the Rishis speak highly of food. The course of the world and the intellectual faculties have all been fixed on food.

sa: यांश्च घोरेण रूपेण पश्येत् क्रुद्धः पिनाकधृत्। न सुरा नासुरा लोके न गन्धर्वा न पन्नगाः॥ कुपिते सुखमेधन्ते तस्मिन्नपि गुहागताः। प्रजापतेश्च दक्षस्य यजतो वितते क्रतौ॥ विव्याध कुपितो यज्ञं निर्भयस्तु भवस्तदा। धनुषा बाणमुत्सृज्य सघोषं विननाद च॥
en: When the holder of Pinaka becomes angry and assuming a terrible mien merely casts his eye upon deity, Asura, Gandharva, or snake, that individual cannot obtain peace of mind by taking shelter in the recesses of even a mountain cave. When that lord of all creatures, viz., Daksha, desirous of celebrating a sacrifice, spread his sacrifice out, the brave Bhava, yielding to anger (at Daksha's slight of him), pierced the Sacrifice. Shooting his arrow from his terrible bow, he roared aloud.

sa: वासुदेव उवाच युधिष्ठिर महाबाहो महाभाग्यं महात्मनः। रुद्राय बहुरूपाय बहुनाम्ने निबोध मे॥
en: Vasudeva said O mighiyarmed Yudhishthira, listen to me as I recite to you the many names of Rudra as also the high blessedness of that great one.

sa: ब्रवीमि सत्यमेतच्च यथाहं पाण्डुनन्दन। तेन सत्येन गच्छेयं लोकान् यत्र च शान्तनुः॥
en: I tell you truly, O son of Pandu! I swear by this truth, by which I hope to acquire all those blissful regions that have been Shantanu's.

sa: राजा तु धृतराष्ट्रश्च पुत्रशोकाभिपीडितः। वाक्यमाह महाबुद्धिः प्रज्ञाचक्षुर्नरेश्वरम्॥ उत्तिष्ठ कुरुशार्दूल कुरु कार्यमनन्तरम्।
en: And gifted with high intelligence and wise vision, king Dhritarashtra greatly afflicted with grief for his sons, addressed the king, saying, Rise up, O foremost of Kurus,

sa: त्वमाजहर्थ देवानामेको वीरश्रियं पराम्। त्वं बिभर्षि भुवं द्यां च सदैव बलसूदन॥
en: You, O hero, alone, bring about the highest prosperity of the celestials, and O slayer of Bala, you sustain the carth as well as the celestial region.

sa: संवर्त उवाच गिरेर्हिमवतः पृष्ठे मुजवान् नाम पर्वतः। तप्यते यत्र भगवांस्तपो नित्यमुमापतिः॥
en: Samvarta said There is a peak named Munjaban on the summits of the Himalaya mountains, where the worshipful husband of Uma (Mahadeva) is constantly practising austere penances.

sa: मातरो विविधा दृष्टाः पितरश्च पृथग्विधाः। सुखानि च विचित्राणि दुःखानि च मयानघ।॥
en: I have seen various kinds of mothers, and various fathers dissimilar to one another. I have come by various kinds of happiness and misery, O sinless one.

sa: तत्र कर्म प्रवक्ष्यामि सुखी भवति येन वै। आवर्तमानो जातीषु यथान्योन्यास सत्तम॥
en: Regarding this, I shall tell you those deeds by which the individual Soul, O best of men, while passing through a repeated round of rebirths, becomes happy.

sa: भुक्तं भुक्तमिदं कोष्ठे कथमनं विपच्यते। कथं रसत्वं व्रजति शोणितत्वं कथं पुनः॥
en: How does this food that is eaten from time to time become digested in the stomach? How does it become changed into juice? How, again, into blood.

sa: तैर्वृतः कुशिको राजा श्रिया परमया ज्वलन्। प्रविवेश पुरं हृष्टः पूज्यमानोऽथ बन्दिभिः॥
en: Surrounded by them all, King Kushika, shining in beauty and splendour, entered his city, with a delighted heart, and his praises were sung by bards and encomiasts.

sa: यतः प्रवर्तते तन्त्रं यत्र च प्रतितिष्ठति। प्राणोऽपान: समानश्च व्यानश्चोदार एव च॥ तत एव प्रवर्तन्ते तदेव प्रविशन्ति च। समानव्यानयोर्मध्ये प्राणापानौ विचेरतुः॥
en: It is that from which proceeds the wellordained universe, and it that upon which it depends. The vital airs called Prana, Apana, Samana, Vyana and Udana, flow from it, and it is that into which they again enter. The vital airs Prana and Apana move between Samana and Vyana.

sa: द्वन्द्वशश्चाब्रुवन् सर्वे पश्यध्वं तपसो बलम्। क्रुद्धा अपि मुनिश्रेष्ठं वीक्षितुं नेह शक्नुमः॥
en: Collected in masses they said to each other-See the might of penances! Although all of us are angry, we are still unable to look at the Rishi.

sa: ब्राह्मणेभ्यश्च ये कामानर्थयिष्यन्ति मां पथि॥ सर्वान् दास्याम्यशेषेण धनं रत्नानि चैव हि।
en: To the Brahmanas who may approach me on the way, I shall grant their wishes and bestow upon all of the them gems and riches without stint.

sa: तमः शूद्रे रजः क्षत्रे ब्राह्मणे सत्त्वमुत्तमम्। इत्येवं त्रिषु वर्णेषु विवर्तन्ते गुणास्त्रयः॥
en: Ignorance is in the Shudra; Darkness in the Kshatriya; and Goodness, which is the highest, in the Brahmana. The three qualities exist thus in the three castes.

sa: अहं प्रजापतीनां च सर्वेषां नात्र संशयः। मम विष्णुरचिन्त्यात्मा स्वयम्भूरिति स स्मृतः॥
en: Of all the Prajapatis I am the first. There is no doubt in this, Of inconceivable soul, the self consistent Vishnu is said to be my superior.

sa: गङ्गे च यमुने चैव सरितश्च सरांसि च। प्रदक्षिणमृर्षि चक्रुर्न औनं पर्यपीडयन्॥
en: Ganga and Yamuna, however, and the other rivers and lakes, whose waters unite together at the confluence at Prayaga, instead of afflicting the Rishi, went beyond him.

sa: न शिल्पजीविकां जीवेद्धिरण्यं नोत कामयेत्। न द्वेष्टा नोपदेष्टा च भवेच्च निरुपस्कृतः॥
en: One should not live by the occupation of an artisan, nor should he covet gold. One should not hate, nor teach; nor should one have any belongings.

sa: निहत्य मानं क्रोधं च प्रहर्षं शोकमेव च। वर्षाणि द्वादश मुनिर्जलवासे धृतव्रतः॥
en: Renouncing pride, anger, joy and grief, the ascetic, pledging himself to observe that vow, set himself to live for twelve years, according to the rules of Udavasa.

sa: त्वत्तेजःसम्भवो नित्यं भूतात्मा मधुसूदन। रतिः क्रीडामयी तुभ्यं माया ते रोदसी विभो॥
en: O destroyer of Madhu, the soul of every creature is always born of your energy. Playful sport is yours. Earth and sky, O lord, are your illusion.

sa: स्मरन्नेव च तं प्राह मातङ्गः प्रहसन्निव! एहुनङ्क प्रतीच्छस्व मनो वारि भृगूद्वह॥
en: As soon as Utanka had thought of Krishna, that hunter smilingly addressed him, saying, O Utanka, oyou or Bhrigu's race, do yoil accept this water from me.

sa: न हि तानश्रुपातांस्तु शक्ता धारयितुं मही॥ गौतमस्त्वव्रवीद् विप्रमुत्तङ्क प्रीतमानसः। कस्मात् तात तवाद्येह शोकोत्तरमिदं मनः। स स्वैरं ब्रूहि विप्रर्षे श्रोतुमिच्छामि तत्त्वतः॥
en: The Earth herself was unable to hold those tear-drops of Utanka. With a pleased heart, Gautama then said to the twice-born Utanka, 'Why, O son, is your mind so afflicted with grief today? Tell me calmly and quietly, O learned Rishi, for I wish to hear it in full.

sa: वैशम्पान उवाच ततो बहुतरं भीरुर्विलप्य कमलेक्षणा। मुमोह दुःखसंतप्ता पपात च महीतले॥
en: Vaishampayana said That lady having eyes like lotus petals, having bewailed much, and burning with grief, at last lost her senses and dropped down on the Earth.

sa: पश्य नागोत्तमसुते भर्तारं निहतं मया। कृतं प्रियं मया नेऽद्य निहत्य समरेऽर्जुनम्॥
en: See, O daughter of the foremost of Snakes, your husband killed by me. Indeed, by killing Arjuna in battle I have accomplished what is pleasant to you.

sa: न हि मे पितरं हत्वा निष्कृतिर्विद्यते क्वचित्। नरकं प्रतिपत्स्यामि ध्रुवं गुरुवधार्दितः॥
en: Having killed my father, there is not rescue for me. Afflicted as I am with the sin of patricide, I shall, forsooth, have to sink in Hell.

sa: न कामभोगान् विपुलान् नालंकारान् न संश्रयान्। तथैव बहु मन्यन्ते यथा रत्यामनुग्रहम्॥
en: Women never prize even profuse articles of enjoyment or ornaments or other delightful things so much as they do the companionship of persons of the opposite sex,

sa: श्रद्धेयवाक्यः प्राज्ञस्त्वं दिव्यं रूपं बिभर्षि च। समागतश्च विप्रैस्त्वं तद् भवान् वक्तुमर्हति॥
en: Your words are creditable. You are wise. You have have, also, a celestial form. You have come into the midst of learned Brahmanas. You should explain yourself.'

sa: अनवेक्ष्य सुतस्नेहं कलत्रस्नेहमेव च॥ धर्ममेव गुरुं ज्ञात्वा तृष्णा न गणिता त्वया।
en: Disregarding filial affection, disregarding the affection one feels for his wife, and reckoning virtue as the foremost, you have paid no attention to the cravings of nature.

sa: तत्पय: स्थापयामास नवे भाण्डे दृढे शुचौ। तच्च क्रोधस्वरूपेण पिठरं धर्म आविशत्॥
en: He then placed the milk in a vessel which was new, durable, and pure. The deity Dharma, assuming the form of anger, entered that vessel of milk.

sa: क्व तदा द्रोणभीष्मौ तौ सोमदत्तोऽपि वाऽभवत्। यत्र त्रयोदशसमा वने वन्येन जीवथ॥
en: Where were Bhishma and Drona then, and where was Somadatta? You had to live for thirteen years in the forest depending on the products of the wilderness.

sa: न शोचितव्यं राजेन्द्र स्वत: स पृथिवीपतिः॥ प्राप्तवानग्निसंयोगं गान्धारी जननी च ते।
en: O king of kings, you should not grieve for him. The monarch, of his own will, as also Gandhari and your mother, got that contact with fire,

sa: ततः प्रबुद्धः कौन्तेयः सर्वं संछिद्य बन्धनम्। पोथयामास तान् सर्वान् केचिद् भीताः प्रदुद्रुवुः॥ हतावशेषा भीमेन सर्वे वासुकिमभ्ययुः। ऊचुश्च सर्पराजानं वासुकिं वासवोपमम्॥
en: The son of Kunti (Bhima), having regained his consciousness, burst open the cords and he then pressed them (snakes) all under the ground. Some fled in boar and the rest, that escaped death from Bhima's hands, went and spoke to Vasuki, the king of the snakes, equal to Indra.

sa: कच्चिन्न लोभान्मोहाद् वा मानाद् वापि विशामाते। अर्थिप्रत्यर्थिनः प्राप्तान् न पश्यसि कथञ्चन॥
en: O king, out of covetousness, or folly or pride you surely never fail to decide the case between the plaintiff and the defendant who come to you?

sa: दश प्राचेतसः पुत्राः सन्तः पुण्यजनाः स्मृताः। मुखजेनाग्निना यैस्ते पूर्वं दग्धा महीरूहाः॥
en: Pracheta had ten sons, who were all devoted to asceticism and they all possessed every virtue. They burnt with the fire of their mouth many medicinal plants.

sa: त्वं विष्णुस्त्वं सहस्राक्षस्त्वं देवस्त्वं परायणम्। त्वं सर्वमनृतं देवः त्वं सोमः परमार्चितः॥
en: You are Vishnu, you have one thousand eyes, you are a deity, you are the final refuge, you are all Ambrosia, you are the much adored Soma.

sa: स ताः पप्रच्छ धर्मात्मा कस्यैषा लोकसुन्दरी। किमर्थमागता चैव सर्वमाख्यात मा चिरम्॥
en: Thereupon the virtuous-souled Budha accosted them saying: Whose daughter is this graceful girl among you and for what she has come here? Do not delay-tell me soon.

sa: फेनपांश्च तथा वत्सान्न दुहन्ति स्म मानवाः। न कूटमानैर्वणिजः पण्यं विक्रीणते तदा॥
en: Men never milched the cows as long as the calves could not live on the milk of their mothers. No merchant sold his goods with false scales.

sa: पुरा वैदर्भको राजा पिता मम महायशाः। सुदेव इति विख्यातस्त्रिषु लोकेषु वीर्यवान्।॥
en: There flourished in the days of yore a highly illustratious and powerful Vidarbha king under the name of Sudeva known over three worlds. He was my father.

sa: तं चैनं परमोदारमुपेक्षसि महाबल। क्षणं हि न भवेत्रः क्रुद्ध त्वयि सुरेश्वर॥
en: Do you therefore not neglect any longer this highly Generous Asura. They self being enraged, O lord of deities, Vſtra shall not live even for a moment.

sa: आपदर्थे धनं रक्षेद् दारान् रक्षेद् धनैरपि। आत्मानं सततं रक्षेद् दारैरपि धनैरपि॥
en: Man cherishes wealth for (rescuing himself) from distress and danger. By wealth be cherishes his wife. He must always cherish himself both by his wealth and wife.

sa: स मे प्रसादं काकुत्स्थ कुरुष्वामितविक्रम। मातृहीनो यथा वत्सो न चिरं प्रवसाम्यहम्॥
en: Do you therefore, O Kākutstha of unmitigated prowess, have compassion on me. Without you, I cannot live for ever in a foreign province like a motherless child.

sa: दुर्बला अपि विप्रा हि बलीयांस: स्वतेजसा। ब्राह्मणो नावमन्तव्यः सदसद् वा समाचरन्॥
en: And becoming emaciated and weak the Brahmanas are ever strong in their own energy. A Brahmana should never be disregarded whether his acts be right or wrong,

sa: स हि तारयितुं सौम्य शक्तः सुरगणानपि। किं पुनस्त्वां महाबाहो क्षुत्पिपासावशं गतम्॥
en: O gentle one, even to the immortals he can give salvation; what wonder it is that he shall relieve you from the miseries of hunger and thirst.

sa: यो नः स्वर्गजितः सर्वान् यथा वृत्तं निवेदयत्। अनुसूयुर्द्विजायेभ्यः स लभेन्नः सलोकताम्॥
en: He who will duly read to the good Brahmanas, the account of our ascension to heaven without malice shall himself attain to the same worlds with us.

sa: स कृत्वा सर्वकार्याणि प्रतस्थे तस्थुषां वरः। उपेत्य स यदुश्रेष्ठो बाह्यकक्षाद् विनिर्गतः॥
en: Having performed all (those) ceremonies, that foremost of all virtuous men, the best of the Yadu race (Krishna), wishing to start, came out to the outer apartments.

sa: गच्छन्तु पुरुषाः शीघ्रं नगरं वारणावतम्। सत्कारयन्तु तान् वीरान् कुन्तिराजसुतां च ताम्॥
en: O man, go quickly to the city of Varanavata and perform the funeral rites of those heroes and of the daughter of the king of Kunti (Bhoja).

sa: आत्मानमपि चोत्सृज्य तप्स्यामि परलोकगः। त्यक्ता ह्येते मया व्यक्तं नेह शक्ष्यन्ति जीवितुम्॥
en: If I sacrifice myself and go to the other world, I shall still be repentant, for being abandoned by me, they would not be able to live.

sa: वैशम्पायन उवाच साध्वयं प्रश्न उद्दिष्टः पाण्डवेय ब्रवीमि ते। तां मांसपेशी भगवान् स्वयमेव महातपाः॥ शीताभिरद्धिरासिच्य भागं भागमकल्पयत्। यो यथा कल्पितो भागस्तं तं धात्र्या तथा नृप॥ घृतपूर्णेषु कुण्डेषु एकैकं प्राक्षिपत् तदा। एतस्मिन्नन्तरे साध्वी गान्धारी सृदृढव्रता॥ दुहितुः स्नेहसंयोगमनुध्याय वराङ्गना। मनसाचिन्तयद् देवी एतत् पुत्रशतं मम॥ भविष्यति न संदेहो न ब्रवीत्यन्यथा मुनिः। ममेयं परमा तुष्टिर्दुहिता मे भवेद् यदि॥
en: Vaishampayana said : O descendant of Pandu, your question is just. I shall tell you how it happened. The great ascetic, the illustrious Rishi himself, sprinkled that ball of fresh with cool water and begin to divide it into hundred parts, O king, as it was being divided into parts, the nurse began to take them up and put them one by one into the jars filled with ghee. In the meanwhile the beautiful and chaste Gandhari of rigid vows, feeling the affection for a daughter. Reflected in her mind, there is no doubt that I shall have one hundred sons. The Rishi had said this and it cannot be otherwise. If a daughter is born to me over and above my one hundred sons, I shall be exceedingly happy.

sa: स्वागतं सर्वथा दिष्ट्या पाण्डोः पश्याम संततिम्। उच्यतां स्वागतमिति वाचोऽश्रूयन्त सर्वशः॥११८ ।
en: Voices, however, were heard from all sides, crying, “They are welcome. Through divine providence, we see before us the sons of Pandu. Let their welcome be proclaimed."

sa: ते त्विषून् दश साहस्रांस्तस्मिन् युगपदाक्षिपन्। अप्राप्तांश्चैव तानाशु भीष्मः सर्वांस्तथान्तरा॥ अच्छिनच्छरवर्षेण महता लोमवाहिना। ततस्ते पार्थिवाः सर्वे सर्वतः परिवार्य तम्॥ ववृषुः शरवर्षेण वर्षेणेवाद्रिमम्बुदाः। स तं बाणमयं वर्षं शरैरावार्य सर्वतः॥ ततः सर्वान् महीपालान् पर्यविध्यात् त्रिभिस्त्रिभिः। एकैकस्तु ततो भीष्यं राजन् विव्याध पञ्चभिः॥
en: The kings hurled at their foe ten thousands arrows at the same time. Bhishma, however, stopped their memberless arrows before they could fall upon him by a counter shower of his own arrows as numerous as the down of the body. Thereupon, the kings surrounded him on all sides and rained upon him a shower of arrows like masses of clouds showering on the mountains. He (Bhishma), stopping that shower of arrows by his own, wounded each of the kings with three arrows. O king, the kings wounded Bhishma each with five arrows.

sa: कालवर्षी च पर्जन्यः सस्यानि रसवन्ति च। सर्वरत्नसमृद्धा च मही पशुमती तथा॥
en: Parjanya (Indra) poured showers of rains at the proper time and the crops were all juicy. The earth was full of all kinds of wealth and animals.

sa: शृंगी नाम महाक्रोधो दुष्प्रसादो महाव्रतः। स देवं परमासीनं सर्वभूतहिते रतम्॥ ब्रह्माणमुपतस्थे वै काले काले सुसंयतः। स तेन समनुज्ञातो ब्रह्मणा गृहमेयिवान्॥
en: Who was named Shringi. He was full of wrath, severe in his vows and difficult to be appeased. He sometimes worshipped with great attention his (preceptor) Brahma, seated on his seat and ever engaged in doing good to all creatures. Commanded by him, he was coming home one day.

sa: देवयानी च दयितां सुतां तस्य महात्मनः। त्वमाराधयितुं शक्तो नान्यः कश्चन विद्यते॥
en: You can also adore Devayani, the favourite daughter of that illustrious man. You are capable of conciliating them both. There is none else who can do it.

sa: भग्नदर्प हृतधनं तं तथा वशमागतम्। स वैरं मनसा ध्यात्वा द्रोणो. दुपदमब्रवीत्॥
en: (Seeing the king) humiliated and deprived of wealth and brought under his complete control, Drona remembered his former hostility towards him and he thus spoke to him.

sa: देवयान्युवाच कस्यैते दारका राजन् देवपुत्रोपमाः शुभाः। वर्चसा रूपतश्चैव सदृशा मे मतास्तव॥
en: Devayani said : O king, whose children are these, so handsome, so like the children of the celestial? They are exactly like you in splendour and beauty.

sa: भूमौ तु निदधुः केचिद् भृगवो धनमक्षयम्॥ ददुः केचिद् द्विजातिभ्यो ज्ञात्वा क्षत्रियतोभयम्।
en: Some of the Bhrigus to save their wealth buried it under the earth and some from the fear of Kshatriyas gave away their wealth to the Brahmanas.

sa: स चकार सभां दिव्यां सर्वरत्नसमार्चिताम्। तस्यां दुर्योधनो मन्दो लोभं चक्रे सुदुर्मतिः॥
en: And he (Maya) built the beautiful assembly-hall, adorned with all sorts of jewels and precious stones. Seeing this building, the wicked Duryodhana was tempted to possess it.

sa: व्यास उवाच आसीत् तपोवने काचिदृषेः कन्या महात्मनः। विलग्ममध्या सुश्रोणी सुभूः सर्वगुणान्विता॥
en: Vyasa said : There lived in a wood a certain illustrious Rishi who had a daughter of slender waist, fair hips, fine eye-brows and of all accomplishments.

sa: मानुषानति गन्धर्वान् सर्वान् गन्धर्व लक्षये। तस्मादस्त्रेण दिव्येन योत्स्येऽहं न तु मायया॥
en: O Gandharva, I know Gandharvas are superior to men (in prowess). I shall therefore fight with you by using the celestials weapons. I shall not use delusions.

sa: पूर्वमभ्यर्दितं दृष्ट्वा भीष्मं शाल्वेन ते नृपाः। विस्मिताः समपद्यन्त साधु साध्विति चाब्रुवन्॥
en: The kings, seeing that Shalva was covering Bhishma at the very outset of the combat with innumerable arrows, were much astonished and they all cried "Blessed, Blessed."

sa: वैशम्पायन उवाच क्रुद्धेनोशनसा शप्तो ययाति हुषस्तदा। पूर्व वयः परित्यज्य जरां सद्योऽन्वपद्यत॥
en: Vaishampayana said :; Thus being cursed by the angry Ushanas, Yayati, the son of Nahusha, was then deprived of his youth and terrible decrepitude soon overcame him.

sa: न चापि तेषां वीराणां जीवतां कुरुनन्दन। पित्र्योंऽशः शक्य आदातुमपि वज्रभृता स्वयम्॥
en: O descendant of Kuru, know that as long as those heroes (the Pandavas) live, the wielder of thunder (Indra) himself cannot deprive them of their paternal property.

sa: चचार पृथिवीं सर्वां यत्र सायंगृहो मुनिः। तीर्थेषु च समाप्लावं कुर्वनटति सर्वशः॥
en: Being Yatra Sayan Griha (living in the place where night overtook him), roamed all over the world, bathed in many sacred waters and visited many holy shrines.

sa: तस्मिन् वने दह्यमाने षडग्निर्न ददाह च। अश्वसेनं मयं चैव चतुरः शाहूकांस्तथा॥
en: In the burning of that forest, he (Agni) speared the lives of only six creatures, (namely) Ashvasena, Maya and the four Sharangakas (a kind of feathery creatures).

sa: वैशम्पायन उवाच ततो रात्र्यां व्यतीतायामन्नमादाय पाण्डवः। भीमसेनो ययौ तत्र यत्रासौ पुरुषादकः॥ आसाद्य तु वनं तस्य रक्षसः पाण्डवो बली। आजुहाव ततो नाम्ना तदनमुपपादयन्॥
en: Vaishampayana said : When the night passed away, the Pandava, Bhimasena, taking with him the food (for the Rakshasa) set out for the place where the cannibal dwelt. Reaching the forest in which the Rakshasas lived, the greatly strong Pandava (Bhima) began to eat himself the food and called loudly the Rakshasas by name.

sa: मय उवाच युक्तमेतत् त्वयि विभो यथाऽऽत्था पुरुषर्षभ। प्रीतिपूर्वमहं किंचित् कर्तुमिच्छामि भारत॥
en: Maya said O lord, O best of men, what you have said fully deserves you. O descendant of Bharata, I gladly desire to do something (for you).

sa: तस्य तस्य प्रसादात् ते राज्ञि पुत्रो भविष्यति। इत्युक्ताहं तदानेन पितृवेश्मनि भारत॥
en: O princes, by each of their favour, you shall have offspring." descendant of the Bharata race, this was told to me by him at my father's house.

sa: यस्मात् प. डुत्वमापन्ना विरूपं प्रेक्ष्य मामिह। तस्मादेव सुतस्ते वै पाण्डुरेव भविष्यति॥
en: The son of Satyavati, Vyasa, spoke to her thus, “As you have become pale by seeing me ugly, so your son will be also pale in complexion.

sa: न मिथ्याहं वदे राम देवलोकजिगीषया। शूद्रं मां विद्धिकाकुत्स्थ शम्बूको नाम नामतः।।३
en: O Kākutstha, I shall never utter a falsehood since I am willing to conquer the region of gods. I am a Sūdra and my name is Sambūka.

sa: क्षत्रियस्य हि गान्धर्वो विवाहः श्रेष्ठ उच्यते। सकामायाः सकामेन निर्मन्त्रो रहसि स्मृतः॥
en: The marriage according to the Gandharva form, without Mantras and between a willing woman and a willing man, is said to be the best to a Kshatriya.

sa: प्राणेभ्योऽपि प्रियतरा भार्गवस्य महात्मनः। त्वं भद्रे धर्मतः पूज्या गुरुपुत्री सदा मम॥७)]
en: You are dearer than life to the high-souled Bhargava. O amiable lady, you are ever worthy of my worship, as you are the daughter of my preceptor.

sa: यथा हि दिवि दीप्तांशुः प्रभासयति तेजसा। तथा भुवि महीपालो दीप्त्या संवरणोऽभवत्॥
en: As Surya in the heavens fills the firmament with his splendour, so did king Samvarana fill region on the earth with the splendour of his good achievements.

sa: हितो ह्ययं सदाऽस्माकं प्रियाकारी च नागराट्। प्रसादं कुरु देवेश शमयास्य मनोज्वरम्॥
en: The king of the snakes is always our friend and benefactor; O lord of the gods, be gracious to him and remove the fever of his mind.

sa: लालप्यमानमेकैकं जरितां च पुनः पुनः। न चैवोचुस्तदा किंचित् तमृषि साध्वसाधु वा॥
en: But he spoke to them one after the other and he spoke also to Jarita, but none of them said ill or well to him in reply.

sa: उलूप्युवाच ऐरावतकुले जातः कौरव्यो नाम पन्नगः। तस्यास्मि दुहिता राजन्नुलूपी नाम पन्नगी॥
en: Ulupi said: O king there is a Naga, named Kaurava, born in the race of Airavata. I am his daughter, I am the Naga maiden, named Ulupi.

sa: तथेत्युक्त्वा तु ते सर्वे जग्मुरावसथान् प्रति। व्युषितायां रजन्यां तु कर्णो राजानमभ्ययात्॥
en: Vaishampayana said: Having said “So be it.” They then all went away to their respective houses. As soon as the night passed, Karna came to the king.

sa: विषह्यं यन्मया कर्तुं कृतमेव निबोध तत्। ततो मामब्रवीद् राजन् प्रहसन् बलवृत्रहा॥
en: “If it be in my power to perform the task then consider it as already performed.” Then, O king, the slayer of Vitra said to me smiling:

sa: प्रजायन्ते सुतान् नार्यो दुःखेन महता विभो। पुष्णन्ति चापि महता स्नेहेन द्विजपुङ्गव॥
en: O worshipful one, women give birth to their children with great pain to themselves; and, O foremost of the Brahmanas they bring them up with great affection.

sa: इदं हि सुमहच्चित्रमर्जुनस्येह संजय। महादेवेन बाहुभ्यां यत् समेत इति श्रुति॥ प्रत्यक्षं सर्वलोकस्य खाण्डवे यत् कृतं पुरा। फाल्गुनेन सहायार्थे वह्नर्दामोदरेण च॥
en: O Sanjaya, this is most wonderful in Arjuna as we have heard that he clasped Mahadeva (Shiva) with his arms. That act also which Falguni (Arjuna) did of old aided by Damodara (Krishna) in order to help Agni to consume the Khandava (forest) was witnessed by all the world.

sa: वैशम्पायन उवाच ततस्ते सहिताः सर्वे दुर्योधनमुपागमन्। अब्रुवंश्च महाराज यदूचुः कौरवं प्रति॥शा
en: Vaishampayana said : O great king, they then all came to Duryodhana and spoke to that Kuru prince all that they (the Gandharvas) had spoken to them.

sa: पूरणार्थं समुद्रस्य पृथिवीमवतारिता। समुद्रश्च यथा पीतः कारणार्थं महात्मना।॥ वातापिश्च यथा नीतः क्षयं स ब्रह्महा प्रभो। अगस्त्येन महाराज यन्मां त्वं परिपृच्छसि॥
en: Was brought down on earth in order to fill the ocean, how for a particular object the ocean was drunk up by the high-souled one (Agastya) and now, O great king, O lord, Vatapi, the destroyer of Brahmanas, was destroyed by Agastya, all that you asked me (to narrate).

sa: अथ कर्म कृतं पापं न चेत् कर्तारमृच्छति। कारणं बलमेवेह जनाञ्छोचामि दुर्बलान्॥
en: If the sin consequent upon actions does not touch the doer then the individual power is the cause and I grieve for those who are weak. son

sa: प्रयत्ने कर्मणि बले स एष त्रिषु वर्तते। उदानमिति तं प्राहुरध्यात्मविदुषो जनाः॥
en: It is present in the three elements of actions, exertion and power and then in that state is called Udana by men learned in the physical science.

sa: स दीप्यमानः सहसान्तरिक्षं प्रकाशयन् मातलिसंगृहीतः। बभौ महोल्केव घनान्तरस्था शिखेव चाग्नेर्खलिता विधूमा॥
en: That flaming car, driven by Matali, suddenly illuminating the firmament, appeared like a mighty meteor hidden in clouds or like the smokeless and blazing tongues of fire.

sa: सदिशं च नभः कायो वायुमनसि मे स्थितः। मया क्रतुशतैरिष्टं बहुभिः स्वाप्तदक्षिणैः॥
en: Space with the cardinal points are my body and the air is my mind. I have performed many hundreds of sacrifices in which Dakshina were in abundance.

sa: यक्षाणां राक्षसानां च दानवानां च संयुगे। राज्ञां च प्रतिलोमानां भस्मान्तकरणं महत्॥ क्षुरान्तममलं चक्रं कालान्तकयमोपमम्। अनुमन्त्र्याहमतुलं द्विषतां विनिबर्हणम्॥ जहि सौभं स्ववीर्येण ये चात्र रिपवो ममा इत्युक्त्वा भुजवीर्येण तस्मै प्राहिणवं रुषा॥
en: “Destroy Saubha with all the enemies that are in it" and saying this, after having inspired it with Mantras. I hurled in anger with the strength of my arms the greatly powerful discuss which reduces to ashes all the Yakshas, Rakshasas, Danavas and kings born in impure races and which is as sharp-edged as the razor, which is without stain as Yama himself, which is incomparable and which kills all enemies.

sa: उद्यन्तं च ततो गच्छेत् पर्वतं गीतनादितम्। सावित्र्यास्तु पदं तत्र दृश्यते भरतर्षभ॥
en: O best of the Bharata race, one should then go to Udyanta mountain resounding with melodious notes. The foot-prints of Savitri are still to be seen there.

sa: पृथिव्यां यानि चान्यानि सत्त्वानि जगतीपते। तानि सर्वाण्यहं तत्र पश्यन् पर्यचरं तदा॥
en: O ruler of the earth, all the other creatures that are on earth were all seen by me in his stomach as I was wandering about there.

sa: ततो बालेन तेनैवमुक्तस्यासीत् तदा मम। निर्वेदो जीविते दीर्घ मनुष्यत्वे च भारत॥
en: O descendant of Bharata, thus addressed by that boy, a sense of total disregard possessed me in respect both of my long life and state of manhood.

sa: भरद्वाजस्य भार्या तु वीरा वीरस्य पिण्डदा। प्राहुराज्येन तस्येज्यां सोमस्येव द्विजाः शनैः॥
en: Vira was the wife of Bharadvaja, she gave birth to Vira. It is said by the Brahmanas that he is worshipped like Soma with offering of Ghee.

sa: अन्तराग्निः स्मृतो यस्तु भुक्तं पचति देहिनाम्। स जज्ञे विश्वभुड्नाम सर्वलोकेषु भारत॥
en: O descendant of Bharata, the fire, which is known as the internal heat by which all foods are digested, is called Sarvabhuk and was begotten by him.

sa: ततः स यानादवरुहा राजा सभ्रातृकः सजनः काननं तत्। स्त्रिविष्टपं शक्र इवामितौजाः॥
en: Thereupon descending from his chariot, the king, the foremost of the pious, with his brothers and followers, entered the forest like Indra of mincasurable prowess entering heaven.

sa: पुरावृत्ताः कथाः पुण्याः सदाचारान् सनातनान्। राज्ञा स्त्रीणामृपीणां च मार्कण्डेय विचक्ष्व नः॥
en: (Graciously) narrate to us (therefore) the sacred events of ancient ages and the eternal rules of righteous conduct by which kings, women and saints should be guided.

sa: देवासुराः ए । यत्ता विनिघ्नन्तः परस्परम्। तत्राजयन् सदा देवान् दानवा घोररूपिणः॥
en: In the days of yore, the Devas and the Danavas were always engaged in destroying one another. The fearful Danavas were always able to vanquish the Devas.

sa: यथर्तुवर्षी भगवान् न तथा पाकशासनः। न चापि सर्वबीजानि सम्यग् रोहन्ति भारत॥
en: O descendant of Bharata, the illustrious chastiser of Paka (Indra) never showers rain according to the season. The seeds that are scattered on earth never spring forth.

sa: अमावास्यां प्रवृत्तायां मुहूर्ते रौद्र एव तु। देवासुरं च संग्रामं सोऽपश्यदुदये गिरौ॥
en: It being the time of the new moon, Shatakratu saw in that Rudra (fearful) moment that the celestials and the Asuras were fighting on the Udaya mountain.

sa: लोमश उवाच ततः स वज्री बलिभिर्दैवतैरभिरक्षितः। आससाद ततो वृत्रं स्थितमावृत्य रोदसी॥
en: Lomasha said : Thereupon that wielder of Vajra (Indra) supported by the powerful celestials came to Vritra who was then occupying both the earth and the heaven.

sa: अगतायां तु वैदर्त्यां सपुत्रायां नलो नृपः। वर्तयामास मुदितो देवराडिव नन्दने॥ तथा प्रकाशतां यातो जम्बुद्वीपे स राजसु। पुनः शशास तद् राज्यं प्रत्याहृत्य महायशाः॥
en: On the arrival of the Vidharbha princess accompanied by her son and daughter, king Nala passed his days in great happiness, like the chief of the celestials in the Nandana (garden). The greatly illustrious king, having regained his kingdom and becoming famous among the kings of the Jambudvipa, began once more to rule it.

sa: मा तात साहसं कार्षीः स्वधर्म परिपालय। स्वधर्मस्थः परंधर्मं बुध्यस्व गमयस्व च॥
en: O child, therefore do not act rashly, do not deviate from the duties of your order. Adhering to your own Dharma, know and follow the highest morality.

sa: शिवोवाच अस्माकं त्वं प्रियो नित्यं बिभीमस्तु वयं तव। त्वच्चित्तमिङ्गित्तैख़त्वा प्रेषितास्मि तवान्तिकम्॥
en: Shiva said: You are always beloved to us, but we are afraid of you. Now knowing your mind by clear signs, they have sent me to you.

sa: स तु विह्वलतां गत्वा प्रतिलभ्य च चेतनाम्। रामः प्रत्यागतप्राणः प्राणमद् विष्णुतेजसम्॥ विष्णुना सोऽभ्यनुज्ञातो महेन्द्रमगमत् पुनः। भीतस्तु तत्र न्यवसद् व्रीडितस्तु महातपाः॥
en: (Parshu) Rama who had been thus deprived of his senses, then regaining his consciousness and receiving back (as it were) his life, bowed to the greatly effulgent Vishnu (Rama). Commanded by Vishnu he again went to the Mahendra mountain. The great ascetic lived there in fear and in shame.

sa: स तूत्थाय महाबाहुरुपसान्त्व्य च तान् जनान्। धनुर्विकृष्य व्यसृजद् बाणान् श्वेते महागिरौ।॥
en: Rising from his seat, that mighty deity dispelled the fear of all creature and then drawing his bow, he discharged his arrows towards the great white mountain.

sa: स तं नादं भृशार्तानां श्रुत्वापि बलिनां वरः। न प्राच्यवदमेयात्मा शक्तिमुद्यम्य चानदत्॥
en: That mighty being of matchless prowess, hearing the groans of the afflicted hills, was not at all moved, but uplifting his mace he yelled forth his cry.

sa: दृष्ट्वा वनगतं पार्थमदुःखार्ह सुखोचितम्॥ न च ते वर्धते मन्युस्तेन मुह्यामि भारत।
en: O king, beholding Partha used to happiness and unworthy of misery, living in the forest. Your anger is not excited, I am stricken with wonder for this.

sa: वैशम्पायन उवाच गते तु पाण्डवे तात काम्यकात् सत्यविक्रमे। बभूवुः पाण्डवेयास्ते दुःखशोकपरायणाः॥
en: Vaishampayana said : O child, when the greatly powerful Pandava, (Arjuna) had gone away from the Kamyaka, the sons of Pandu were filled with sorrow and grief.

sa: ततः कौरवसैन्यानां प्रादुरासीन्महास्वनः॥ प्रयातान् सहितान् दृष्ट्वा पाण्डुपुत्रान् महारथान् जितकाशिनश्च खचरास्त्वरिताश्च महारथाः॥ क्षणेनैव वने तस्मिन् समाजग्मुरभीतवत्। न्यवर्तन्त ततः सर्वे गन्धर्वा जितकाशिनः॥
en: Thereupon, the Kuru soldiers sent up a very loud shout. O seeing the great car-warriors the sons of Pandu going to fight with the Gandharvas). Those rangers of the sky (Gandharvas), the great car-warriors, were flushed with victory. Those warriors, the Pandavas, fearlessly encountered one other in the forest.

sa: लोहितस्योदधेः कन्या धात्री स्कन्दस्य सा स्मृता॥ लोहितायनिरित्येवं कदम्बे सा हि पूज्यते।
en: The daughter of the deity of blood is said to be the nurse of Skanda. She is therefore worshipped under the name of Lohitayani on Kadamba trees.

sa: गदां गुर्वी समुद्यम्य त्वरितश्च वृकोदरः। स्वस्थं योजयित्वाऽऽशु निर्यात इति नः श्रुतम्॥
en: We are told that Vrikodara (Bhima), hastily ordering his chariot to be made ready and then riding on it, frequently whirling his heavy club is proceeding along.

sa: यावत् सप्ततिवर्षाणि भवन्त्येते ग्रहा नृणाम्। अतः परं देहिनां तु ग्रहतुल्यो भवेज्ज्वरः॥
en: Until men attain the age of one hundred years these evil spirits continue to persecute them. Afterwards fever becomes the only evil spirit that affects human beings.

sa: गङ्गायां हि न शक्नोमि बृहत्वाच्चेष्टितुं प्रभो। समुद्रं नय मामाशु प्रसीद भगवन्निति॥
en: "O lord, I am unable to move about in the Ganga on account of my huge body. Therefore, O exalted one, take me soon to the sea.”

sa: मार्कण्डेय उवाच इत्युक्त्वा विससर्जेनं परिष्वज्य महेश्वरः। विसर्जिते ततः स्कन्दे बभूवौत्पातिकं महत्॥
en: Markandeya said : Having said this, Maheshvara Maheshvara (Shiva) embraced him and then permitted him to go. When Skanda was thus allowed to go, great disasters occurred.

sa: नाहं ब्रूयां पुनर्जातु क्षत्रियोऽस्मीति भारत। भो भो राक्षस तिष्ठस्व सहदेवोऽस्मि पाण्डवः॥
en: O descendant of Bharata, I will not then any more say that I am a Kshatriya. Ho, Ho, Rakshasa, stay, I am the son of Pandu, Sahadeva.

sa: प्रतिषिद्धा हि ते याचा यया सिद्ध्यति वै द्विजः। तेजसैवार्थलिप्सायां यतस्व पुरुषर्षभ॥
en: O best of men, in your case, begging, which is a success to the Brahmanas, has been forbidden. Therefore try to acquire wealth by prowess and energy.

sa: तं क्रोधं वर्जितंधीरैः कथमस्मद्विधश्चरत्। एतद् द्रौपदि संधाय न मे मन्युः प्रवर्धते॥
en: Why should persons like myself indulge in that anger which has been controlled by persons of tranquil mind; thinking this, O Draupadi, my anger is not excited.

sa: अथ वा मन्यसे कृष्णं स्थविरं कुरुपुङ्गव। वसुदेवे स्थिते वृद्धे कथमर्हति तत्सुतः॥
en: O foremost man of the Puru race, if you consider him to be the eldest, why, here is Vasudeva. How can his son be worshipped before him?

sa: भरद्वाज उवाच ब्राह्मणानां किलार्थाय ननु त्वं तप्तवांस्तपः। द्विजानामनधीता वै वेदाः सम्प्रतिभान्त्विति॥
en: Bharadvaja said : For the good of the Brahmana you performed the severe austerities, so that the Vedas unstudied by any Brahmanas might be manifest in you.

sa: प्रभासते यथा सोमः सोऽश्वमेधं च विन्दति। वरदानं ततो गच्छेत् तीर्थं भरतसत्तम॥
en: Blazes forth like the Moon and obtains the fruits of Ashvamedha sacrifice. O best of the Bharata race, one should then go to the Tirtha named Vasudeva,

sa: शकुनिरुवाच गवावं बहुधेनूकमपर्यन्तमजाविकम्। गजाः कोशो हिरण्यं च दासीदासाश्च सर्वशः॥ एष नो ग्लह एवैको वनवासाय पाण्डवाः। यूयं वयं वा विजिता वसेम वनमाश्रिताः॥ त्रयोदशं च वै वर्षमज्ञाताः सजने तथा। अनेन व्यवसायेन दीव्याम पुरुषर्षभाः॥
en: Shakuni said. O son of Pandu, we have many kine and horse and milch cows and innumerable goats and sheep and elephants, treasures, gold and servants, both male and female. All these have been staked by us before. But now let this be our stake, namely exile into forest (for twelve years) and then living in the thirteenth year unrecognised in an inhabited place. O foremost of men, with this stake let us (now ) play.

sa: क्वचित् पद्भ्यां ततोऽगच्छद् राक्षसैरुह्यते क्वचित्। तत्र तत्र महातेजा भ्रातृभिः सह सुव्रतः॥
en: And that one (Yudhishthira) of unrivalled energy and pious vows at some places walked on foot with his brothers and at others was carried by the Rakshasa.

sa: कुर्वतो नार्थसिद्धिर्मे भवतीति ह भारत। निर्वेदो नात्र कर्तव्यो द्वावन्यौ ह्या कारणम्॥
en: O descendant of Bharata, no one should despair saying, “I am working still I do not succeed," for besides exertion there are two other ause for success.

sa: तस्माच्छश्वत् त्यजेत् क्रोधं पुरुषः सम्यगाचरन्। श्रेयान् स्वधर्मानपगो न क्रुद्ध इति निश्चितम्॥
en: The person, who wishes to behave with decorum, should renounce anger; even one who has forsaken the virtues of his own order, docs not indulge in anger.

sa: जारासंधिं सान्त्वयित्वा करे च विनिवेश्य ह। तैरेव सहितैः सर्वैः कर्णमभ्यद्रवद् बली॥
en: Having subjugated the son of Jarasandha by conciliation and having made him pay tribute, the hero, accompanied by all the kings he had vanquished, marched against Karna.

sa: न हि मे शृण्वतस्तृप्तिरस्ति तेषां विचेष्टितम्। वैशम्पायन उवाच एतदात्महितं श्रुत्वा तस्याप्रतिमतेजसः॥
en: Vaishampayana said : The most exalted on the Bharatas, having heard the instructions of that one of incomparable energy (Arstisena), began always to abide by them accordingly.

sa: दृश्यसे दृश्यसे राजन्नेष दृष्टोऽसि नैषध। आवार्य गुल्मैरात्मानं किं मां न प्रतिभाषसे॥
en: You are discovered O king! you discovered! O ruler of the Nishadhas I have scen you! concealing yourself behind the corpses, why do you not answer me?

sa: ते सर्वे विनिवर्तन्तां ये च मिष्टभुजो द्विजाः। पक्वान्नलेह्यपानानां मांसानां च विकल्पकाः॥
en: Let those Brahmanas also that live on sweet meats, that desire cooked food and the food that is sucked or drunk and meat desist (from following me).

sa: वैशम्पायन उवाच एवमुक्त्वा मताक्षस्तान् ग्लहे सर्वानवस्थितान्। पराजयं लोकवीरानुक्त्वा राज्ञां पृथक् पृथक्॥
en: Vaishampayana said Having said this, (Shakuni), well-skilled in dice, spoke to all the brave kings present there of having won all the Pandavas one after the other.

sa: चषालयूपचमसाः स्थाल्यः पात्र्यः स्रुचः सुवाः। तेष्वेव चास्य यज्ञेषु प्रयोगाः सप्त विश्रुताः॥
en: It is heard that in all these sacrifices seven sets of stakes, of rings for sacrificial stakes, of spots, ladles, utensils and spoons were prepared by him.

sa: प्रायश्चित्तं न तस्यास्ति योधर्ममभिशङ्कते। ध्यायन् स कृपणः पापो न लोकान् प्रतिपद्यते॥
en: Whoever, doubts religion has no expatiation of his sin; that wretched and vile person feels anxicty (here) and does not attain to the regions (of bliss) hereafter.

sa: तस्मादर्हसि शत्रुघ्न सत्यं कर्तुं नरेश्वर। उक्तवानसि यद् वीर मत्सकाशे पुरा वचः॥
en: "Therefore, O slayer of your adversaries! O lord of men! O brave one! you ought to fulfill your promise, that you did make before, in my presence.

sa: निषधेषु महाराजः श्वशुरो मे नरोत्तमः। गृहीतनामा विख्यातो वीरसेन इति स्म ह॥
en: My father-in-law, the foremost of men, was the illustrious sovereign ruling over the Nishadhas. He was known under the name of Virasena and was of high renown.

sa: इत्येवं चिन्तयानस्य पार्थस्यामिततेजसः। ततो वैदूर्यवर्णाभो भासयन् सर्वतो दिशः। यादोगणवृतः श्रीमानाजगाम जलेश्वरः॥
en: While Partha, of incomparable prowess, was thus meditating, there came the effulgent lord of waters, brilliant like Vaidurya, dazzling all the quarters and accompanied by aquatic animals.

sa: धन्योऽस्म्यनुगृहीतोऽस्मि यन्मया त्र्यम्बको हरः। पिनाकी वरदो रूपी दृष्टः स्पृष्टश च पाणिना॥
en: Fortunate and favoured am I for I have both seen and touched with my hand the three-eyed Hara, the wielder of Pinaka in his boon giving form.

sa: क्रूरस्य तस्य स्वपतो बालुकान्तर्हितस्य च। संवत्सरस्य पर्यन्ते निःश्वासः सम्प्रवर्तते।॥ यदा तदा भूश्चलति सशैलवनकानना। तस्य निःश्वासवातेन रज उद्भूयते महत्॥ आदित्यपथमाश्रित्य सप्ताहं भूमिकम्पनम्। सविस्फुलिङ्गं सज्वालं धूममिश्रं सुदारुणम्॥ तेन राजन् न शक्नोमि तस्मिन् स्थातुं स्व आश्रमे तं विनाशय राजेन्द्र लोकानां हितकाम्यया॥
en: O king, when at the end of every year that wicked Asura, lying covered with sands, wakes up and begins to breathe, then the whole earth with her mountains, forests and woods begins to tremble. His breath raises up clouds of sands and covers the very sun. For seven days continually the earth trembles and sparks and flames of fire mixed with smoke spread all over the ground. For all this, O king, I cannot enjoy peace in my hermitage. O king of kings, kill him therefore for the good of the world.

sa: मार्कण्डेय उवाच शृणु राजन्निदं सर्वं यथावृत्तं नराधिप। कथ्यमानं महाप्राज्ञ विस्तरेण यथातथम्॥
en: Markandeya said : O king, O ruler of men, O greatly wise one, hear all this as I narrate it in detail with all its true particulars.

sa: एवं भवतु गच्छेति तमुवाच पितामहः। स एवमुक्तस्तत्पादौ मूर्धा स्पृश्य जगाम ह॥
en: The grandsire answered him, saying, "So be it and do you go away". Having been thus addressed, he touched his feet by his head and went away.

sa: तं भीमः समरश्लाघी गुरुं पितृसमं रणे। विव्याध पञ्चभिर्भल्लैस्तथा षष्ट्या च भारत॥
en: Then, O Bharata, Bhima, that hero ever proud in battle, pierced his sire-like preceptor first with five broad-headed arrows and then with another sixty of the same.

sa: अथ सैन्यस्य मध्ये तु प्राक्रोशत् पाण्डवाग्रजः। योऽस्मान् वृणोति तमहं वरये साह्यकारणात्॥
en: Then, in the midst of all the warriors the eldest Pandava thus loudly exclaimed "He, who will choose us, will be considered by us as our ally".

sa: ततोऽब्रवीच्छान्तनवः सर्वानेव महारथान्। एष भीमो रणे क्रुद्धो धार्तराष्ट्रान् महारथान्॥ यथा प्राच्यान् यथा ज्येष्ठान् यथा शूरांश्च संगतान्। निपातयत्युग्रधन्वा तं प्रगृह्णीतं माचिरम्॥
en: Thereupon the son of Shantanu thus addressed the mighty car-warriors of his army, This fierce bowman, Bhima, inflamed with wrath, is slaughtering in battle the mighty sons of Dhritarashtra, accomplished in weapons, heroic, courageous and united though they are. Do you all receive that son of Pandu in battle”.

sa: यस्य सर्वं तदा ह्यन्नं मनोऽभिप्रायगं शुचि। कामतो बुभुजुर्विप्राः सर्वे चान्नार्थिनो द्विजाः॥ पयो दधि घृतं क्षौद्रं भक्ष्यं भोज्यं च शोभनम्। यस्य यज्ञेषु सर्वेषु वासांस्याभरणानि च॥ ईप्सितान्युपतिष्ठन्ते प्रहृष्टान् वेदपारगान्। मरुतः परिवेष्टारो मरुत्तास्याभवन् गृहे॥
en: At his sacrifices the twice-born sects desirous of food all ate as it pleased them-food that was purified and suited to their tastes. At all his sacrifices, milk and curds and clarified butter and honey and other kinds of drinks and edibles, all of the finest sort and garments and ornaments precious and desirable, used to be given to Brahmanas thoroughly acquainted with the scriptures. The very gods became the distributors of food in Marutta's palace.

sa: वरं वृणीष्व भद्रं ते यादृशं पुत्रमीप्सितम्। तथोक्तः प्राञ्जली राजा पुत्रं वद्रे गुणान्वितम्॥ यशस्विनं कीर्तिमन्तं तेजस्विनमरिंदमम्। यस्य मूत्रं पुरीषं च क्लेदः स्वेदश्च काञ्चनम्॥
en: Good betide you. Ask for the boon about the kind of the son wish to have.' Thus addressed, the king with folded palms, solicited the boon of getting a son endued with all qualities, famous, possessed of glory, highly energetic and subduer of all foes, whose urine, excreta, secretions and perspiration would be gold.”

sa: संजय उवाच एवमुक्त्वा ततो भीष्मं पञ्चभिर्नतपर्वभिः। अविध्यत रणे भीष्मं प्रणुन्नं वाक्यसायकैः॥
en: Sanjaya said Having thus spoken, ne, with five shafts of depressed knots, pierced Bhishma in battle who had already been deeply pierced with the former's wordy arrow.

sa: प्रवर्तते॥ विद्याविनयसम्पन्ने ब्राह्मणे गवि हस्तिनि। शुनि चैव श्वपाके च पण्डिताः समदर्शिनः॥
en: The truly wise men look on a Brahmana, endued with learning and humility and on a cow, an elephant, a dog and a Chandala, as all alike.

sa: तत्राक्रन्दो महानासीत् तव तेषां च भारत। निघ्नतां दृढमन्योन्यं कुर्वतां कर्म दुष्करम्॥
en: Then when they were thus slaughtering one another mercilessly and achieving feats difficult of being accomplished, fierce was the battle that raged between your and their warriors.

sa: यस्य वीर्यं समाश्रित्य द्यूतं पुत्रस्तवाकरोत्। सशेते निहतो राजन् संख्ये भीष्मः शिखण्डिना॥
en: O king, relaying on whose energy, your son played in that match at dice, that great Bhishma now lies in the field of battle killed by Shikhandin.

sa: अपि चेत् सुदुराचारो भजते मामनन्यभाक्। साधुरेव स मन्तव्यः सम्यग्व्यवसितो हि सः॥
en: If even an exceedingly wicked man worship Me, without worshipping any one else, he should certainly be regarded as a good (man), for his efforts are well-directed.

sa: तमुग्रतपसः सिद्धाः सुव्रताः सत्यवादिनः। पश्यन्ति न हि दुर्वृत्तैः शक्यो द्रष्टुं महेश्वरः॥
en: The Siddhas who are truthful, who are of excellent vows and austere asceticism can see him. Maheshvara is incapable of being seen by men of bad conduct.

sa: तेषां तु प्रमुखे शूरं सुशर्माणं महाबलम्। मध्ये सर्वस्य सैन्यस्य भृशं संहर्षयन्निव॥
en: Also, addressing the heroic Susharma endued with great strength, and stationed at their head, Duryodhana said these words, amidst all the soldiers, impairing delight to them all.
